| | Peter, I'm sure you've seen the news that a handful of judges in Colorado just unilaterally kicked President Trump OFF off the ballot in 2024.

My reaction? It's total BS. The hypocrites claiming to defend democracy are actually the ones going out of their way to destroy it.

**I'm fired up. In fact, I just posted a video sharing my thoughts.**

[_> > Watch the video and then PLEASE rush in a contribution today to help me fight back against my own opponents who will clearly do ANYTHING to win this election._](https://maxforoc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0d5d4fbfb4ace920581f6c90d&id=e6eff4b369&e=86e91e802d)

| This is a direct, politically-motivated attack on President Trump and his supporters and their right to vote.

President Trump hasn't even been charged with the crime they're saying he committed in order to justify their attempt to remove him from the ballot.

_Even worse, I'm alarmed that the Democrats running for Congress in MY race here in Orange County support what Colorado is doing!_

_They call OUR efforts to secure our elections voter suppression while they support removing a candidate from the ballot altogether on bogus grounds??_

There is a lot at stake here. The voters - not a handful of liberal judges in Colorado - should decide who they want to be the next President of the United States.

[_> > So please watch the video and donate whatever you can TODAY to make sure we have the resources we need to fight back against these people._](https://maxforoc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0d5d4fbfb4ace920581f6c90d&id=6b38fc129c&e=86e91e802d)

The future of our elections could depend on it.

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=4815%2E5257348%2EKbZB5v ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Hi Derek — My
name is Ed Schiff, but you can call me Boca Eddie (because I live in sunny
Boca Raton, FL now). I’m almost 96.

I’m the proud father of two sons, Dan, the oldest, and Adam, who is
running for the U.S. Senate. I hope you’ll let me take a moment to share a
few thoughts about his campaign.

But first, let me introduce myself. I am originally from Boston, and left
high school early to join the Army at the end of World War II. When I got
out of the service, I went to the University of Alabama on the GI bill,
but left early to get started in business. I married a wonderful woman
named Sherry, got a job as a traveling salesman in the schmata (clothing)
business, and that job enabled our family to buy our first home.

We moved around — from Massachusetts to Arizona — and eventually settled
in Alamo/Danville, in the Bay Area, while Adam was in grade school. I got
out of the schmata business and purchased a small lumber yard, where Dan
and Adam worked during the summer. We became members of a reform synagogue
called Temple Isaiah in Lafayette and put down our roots.

While Dan and Adam were growing up, Sherry and I always wanted them to be
curious boys. To ask lots of questions, to listen and learn about history,
civics, politics, and culture. It was also important to us that our boys
were service-oriented, generous, and compassionate — willing to lend a
helpful hand to a stranger, and work toward a shared belief that a better
world is possible.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=dec2023_abs_em.181qVM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC90_20231220_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=4815%2E5257348%2EKbZB5v ]On the left, an old photo of Adam with his parents Ed and Sherry; on
the right, a recent photo of Adam with his brother, Dan, and his father,
Ed

We always made sure that growing up our boys paid attention in school and
took their studies seriously. I frequently told Adam that even when they
take everything away from you, they can’t take your education away.

Sherry is gone now, and I miss her. I’m also incredibly proud of the men
that my sons have become. Dan is a talented writer and businessman. And
Adam began his work as a federal prosecutor going after companies for
polluting our environment, then served in the legislature before going to
Congress to fight for more affordable health care.

In his public service career, Adam has gone above and beyond to make a
difference — a real difference — in people’s lives. To ease burdens and
make their lives just a little bit better.

I am particularly proud of what Adam has done to stand up to bullies like
Donald Trump. I would tell you what I think of Trump, but that would
involve a number of words not appropriate for this email. (Although I can
tell you, my bubbie would have called him a schmuck.)

It hasn’t been easy to watch the attacks leveled against Adam, or to hear
about the threats to his life and to his beautiful family. These attacks
have not relented. They come from all directions. From Trump himself, his
allies in the media, his cronies in Congress. And I always tell Adam —
don’t let the bastards get you down.

And he hasn’t. Adam rises above — because he believes in our democracy and
in our ability to make a difference.

That’s why he’s running for the United States Senate. So he can keep up
the fight for working families, for his children and my grandchildren, for
us all.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=dec2023_abs_em.181qVM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC90_20231220_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=4815%2E5257348%2EKbZB5v ]Now that you’ve learned more about Adam’s upbringing and what motivates
him, I hope you will chip in to his campaign for Senate today. I’m proud
of Adam, and I know he will be an incredible U.S. Senator. You will be
proud of him too.

She fights to ensure that the wealthy and big corporations pay their fair share. She's worked to create good-paying, clean-energy jobs across our state. I'll keep this short
| | |
---
Hi friend, it's Debbie. I'm between late-night meetings right now, so I'll keep this pretty short.
You might have heard already, but last night, we fell short of our $150,000 goal. Thankfully, we've been able to extend our deadline for another 48 hours to give us one last chance to make up the difference.
This is our final goal before our end-of-quarter deadline. If we can't make up the gap here, we'll fall short of our goal for the whole quarter. So I'm personally asking: **If you're all in to flip Florida blue, will you chip in now? Here's a personal donation link that I made for you:[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/mw_dmp_2023_email_fr](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75550166/445033954/-1832279535?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk479-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWEwNjM4YmEtYWQ5Zi1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XTG5z8EU4_1eULj93v1YdbNSB4fcLCD67sbYGWAc-Pk=)**
Listen, Rick Scott is worth up to a _quarter of a billion dollars_. In 2018, he ended up pouring $64 million of his own money into buying this seat. But here's what he doesn't want you to know: **Even after spending a fortune, he STILL only won this seat by 0.12% — that's just 10,033 votes!**
A well-funded, united grassroots team can _absolutely_ defeat Rick Scott next year. And winning here would practically guarantee a blue Senate in 2024. But if we're missing key goals like this one, Rick Scott _will_ outspend us, he _will_ drown out our message, and he _will_ win.
_So please, friend, if you're able, will you chip in $5 or $25 before my extended deadline?_**Every dollar helps to flip this seat blue and save our Senate majority. Here's that donation link again:[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/mw_dmp_2023_email_fr](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75550167/445033955/-1832279535?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk479-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWEwNjM4YmEtYWQ5Zi1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=XTG5z8EU4_1eULj93v1YdbNSB4fcLCD67sbYGWAc-Pk=)**
Thank you so much,

Debbie

body:
Machines like the ones in this picture are popping up all across America.

| **Reverse ‘money machines’ popping up across America** Machines like the ones in this picture are popping up all across America. [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37163%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EVhHe7ixUpBlQGiD8rubbA&sysid=1) If you’ve been to a concert venue, stadium, or airport, you’ve almost certainly walked by one without knowing. The experts are calling it a **'Reverse ATM'** They’ve been installed at places like Citizen’s Bank Ballpark in Philadelphia... They’ve even been used at the Super Bowl. Why are these machines suddenly appearing out of nowhere? And what does it mean for your money? We’ve recently arranged an interview with former Goldman Sachs managing director, Dr. Nomi Prins, to get her take. There’s nobody in America who’s more aware of the inner workings of the banking system. In the interview, **[Dr. Prins explained these strange ‘reverse ATMs.’](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37164%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=B7%2fSdFkQMunwGS1oDWekcg&sysid=1)** And she said she expects them to play a key role this Summer as our nation’s financial system is overhauled for the first time since 1971. body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjs8k9jgtk98n005np3sp23bu2ddfmrlj99duano_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chhm0p30cph2bs)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zm7rl82fk7habi94k4ul7g7dsug5hto42m31hqdg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chhm0p30cph2bs)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zs8e6o6s20hq6ggrd61jh7k8esok0dp68nfe4hh0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chhm0p30cph2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z0nln4ed9nj0qc63dod3amntb4b0f1n47g4h72ro_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chhm0p30cph2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37171%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lM87LN8piSIi5N04qQBEfQ&sysid=1 "SkyTree Book Fairs")

Friend,

SkyTree Book Fair and I did a deep dive and discovered the cause of why sexually explicit and disgusting books get into our children’s schools, classrooms, and libraries.

Here’s what we’re up against.

These are books Scholastic promotes at book fairs in schools. Here are pages from “Welcome to St. Hell,” a 2022 Scholastic book glamorizing gender transitioning to middle schoolers. (We’ve censored these pages as the original content could violate social media policies against adult material):

[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37172%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uDg9vi7lQat12VZ%2bUyZ2ag&sysid=1)[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37172%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uDg9vi7lQat12VZ%2bUyZ2ag&sysid=1)

Scholastic holds a virtual monopoly on school book fairs. Like many of our cultural institutions in the last decade, Scholastic has fallen prey to the woke mob and radical LGBT political agenda.

Scholastic promotes this agenda over the well-being of our children.

**Here is the solution:**

SkyTree Book Fair offers schools a different option for book fairs. SkyTree Book Fairs is providing schools, parents, and children with an empowering alternative with literature rooted in truth and family values that matches the quality and ease of Scholastic while countering their harmful agenda.

Here’s how you can help.

[I am asking for your urgent support to help SkyTree replace Scholastic in schools. Can you donate $35, $50, or even $100 today toward Sky Tree? We are kicking off with a goal to raise $100,000 this month.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37173%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=oAzlY4lUh1Vxzyj7v%2f8MDA&sysid=1)

[Donate](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37174%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8A0VzNz%2fgKNis5kWDatSqA&sysid=1)

SkyTree was inspired by my first children’s book, As You Grow. Now, I am helping them spread to schools across the country as an alternative to Scholastic. And here’s the thing: SkyTree will not only promote age-appropriate books, but they will do so more efficiently to make it easier for schools to choose SkyTree over Scholastic.

And it’s working!

SkyTree has already secured its first public school book fair in Spotsylvania, VA!

No more race-infused storylines. No more confusing gender content. Only age-appropriate content that will nurture childhood innocence and character.

SkyTree needs your support today. American children need your support today!!

We are quickly lining up hundreds of new book fairs in the Spring semester. It costs roughly $7,500 to host a book fair. Please help sponsor SkyTree book fairs in schools across the country.

It’s not complicated! It’s what you and I grew up with.

Thank you for helping us offer schools an alternative to Scholastic!

God bless,

Kirk Cameron

Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zc14qt1lcbjvaqs0mlhdnlkubddsmu112on8ru00_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chhmcor4c1h2bs)**

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpktuna2j3oak1gjrdk06i953fk4k901shjj9o8g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chhmcor4c1h2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z299jscup19ph35hh09l95ior0en098t9ph2mcu0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chhmcor4c1h2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute
---
The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

annals of history, military triumphs and defeats have been

However,
as we delve deeper into the past, we uncover a truth that

by the savior generals-visionary leaders displaying unparalleled
expertise.

leaders.

rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment

This is
your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most

Greg

subject: FWD: WA Democrats are, collectively, the Christmas Grinch
body:
Did you see the previous email?

Wishing you a Merry Christmas and joyous holiday season from Shift Washington!

Despite the challenges faced by many Washington state families this year, thanks to persistent inflation and new taxes, Democrats seem determined to make life more difficult and expensive.

The lessons from 2023 show that their policies are unpopular and destructive, yet Democrats continue with extreme measures:
* The carbon tax hikes the burden on working families, impacting both fuel costs, home heating, and everything that requires transportation.
* The long-term care tax takes more from workers' paychecks without significant benefits.
* The creation of a state income tax, starting with capital gains, is causing concern.
* Soft-on-crime policies, such as the ban on police pursuits, causing rising crime in our communities.

For all these reasons, we are dubbing Washington's legislative Democrats as this year's Christmas Grinch.

**[Shift WA is committed to holding our state accountable, from exposing liberal networks to challenging extreme plans. Can you support our efforts in 2024 with a contribution of $10, $25, or $50?](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62596461:Wy0JduiNH:m:1:2610672541:66908EEC682D875979A6590B51222944:r)**

Thank you,

The Shift WA Team
We're naming Washington's legislative Democrats as the collective Christmas Grinch for all the ways they managed to ruin 2023 for working families across our state. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62596462:Wy0JduiNH:m:1:2610672541:66908EEC682D875979A6590B51222944:r "Shift Washington")

Friends,

We here at Shift Washington want to wish you and your family a very Merry Christmas and joyous holiday season!

Unfortunately, as in so many recent years, we know it's been a tough one for many families across Washington state. Inflation remains a problem. And, on top of high prices for basic services, the many new taxes imposed by Democrats in Olympia appear intent on making life more difficult - and far more expensive - for everyday families.

If there's one political lesson Democrats should have learned from 2023, it's that their policies are destructive and highly unpopular. Unfortunately, Democrats rarely engage in introspective thoughts. They are moving full speed ahead on enforcing their extreme measures. Here are a few examples:

* The Democrat carbon tax has left working families struggling to cover basic living expenses, from the cost of they pay at the pump to the cost of heating their homes, to their everyday groceries.
* The Democrats' long-term care tax promises to take even more money out of workers' paychecks, with little-to-no benefit in return.
* The Democrats' unconstitutional state income tax, starting with capital gains, is so sketchy that the U.S Supreme Court has it under review.
* Finally, the Democrats' soft-on-crime policies - like their ban on police pursuits - have effectively blocked law enforcement officers from doing their job, causing rising crime rates.

_It 's these policies that require naming Washington's legislative Democrats as this year's Christmas Grinch._

Shift WA has spent a decade as a voice of accountability in our state, from uncovering the liberal attack network pouring millions into the far-Left's agenda to the continual efforts to expose Gov. SkyTree Book Fair and I did a deep dive and discovered the cause of why sexually explicit and disgusting books get into our children's schools, classrooms, and libraries.

SkyTree Book Fair offers schools a different option for book fairs. SkyTree Book Fairs is providing schools, parents, and children with an empowering alternative with literature rooted in truth and family values that matches the quality and ease of Scholastic while countering their harmful agenda.

And it's working!

SkyTree has already secured its first public school book fair in Spotsylvania, VA!

subject: Help me train the next generation of leaders…
body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z57sgog1809ji73etkal45rkb45n4ppnr89v1hqo_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chhmepb1clh2bs)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z65kkne21ffvj3jhikt4bqlf754evcktqkvs932g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chhmepb1clh2bs)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zncjvjund33c36tmsth9nk5vin3ad40fi90v8qrg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chhmepb1clh2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmo4vgrobkeh2spogslliop208q1dhg9h5lj6s1g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chhmepb1clh2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

name: Senator Rand Paul
subject: This petition will make them go ballistic
body:
It's a win-win scenario

Dear Concerned American,

Your petition to Senate Minority Leader Mitch
McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators, and your
Congressman is linked below.

It's vital that you submit your petition
immediately.

Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, Joe
Biden, and the Big Labor bosses are about to go ballistic.

I have introduced the National Right to Work
Act to repeal forever Big Labor's power to force workers to pay
union dues in order to work.

So the union lobbyists, Chuck Schumer, Hakeem
Jeffries, and their allies are going to use every trick in the
book to bury the National Right to Work Bill.

And they want to do it as quietly as
possible.

The union kingpins (and their water-carriers
in Congress) can't afford the consequences of having their
coercive privileges publicly debated and voted on in Congress!

They don't want the American people to know
that:

*** Millions of workers are forced to
surrender part of every paycheck to keep their jobs.

This cash funds violent "organizing" drives,
a limousine lifestyle for union bigwigs, and bankrolls radical,
tax-and-spend politicians like Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and
Hakeem Jeffries.
*** Big Labor's power is deadly to millions
of small businesses.

Big Labor politicians and stacked bureaucrats
are strangling small businesses with confiscatory taxes,
destructive laws, and straitjacket regulations.
*** Forced unionism exports millions of good
jobs overseas.

Productivity-killing work rules, workplace
class warfare, slowdowns, "sick-outs," and strikes all take their
crippling toll, closing the doors of many businesses -- for good.
In the fight to force votes on a National
Right to Work law, opponents of forced unionism will face a
showdown against the full might of Big Labor.

That's why it's vital that you act at once to
ignite massive public support for a National Right to Work Bill.

Now is the time to act.

By the time the Right to Work Bill comes up
for a vote, every member of Congress must realize the eyes of the
American people will be watching.

National opinion polls all show that 80% of
the American people agree it's wrong to force workers to pay
union dues under the threat of being fired if they don't pay!

And the National Right to Work Committee, who
has led the fight against forced dues for over 50 years, must
have your help in demonstrating that to Congress.

If the public's attention is fixed on this
battle, Congress will be forced to recognize -- or defy to its
peril -- the massive public opposition to compulsory unionism.

Then we'll see who dares to stand with Big
Labor. . .

. . . and who stands with freedom and the
American people.

It's vital you click to submit your petition
to Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your Senators,
and your Congressman immediately to demonstrate to Congress and
the national media the strong support for Right to Work.

It's all part of the National Right to Work
Committee's four-part plan to pass a National Right to Work law:

*** Contact directly by mail up to 10 million
supporters, urging them to demand their Senators and Congressmen
vote for the National Right to Work Bill;
*** Brief personally the hundreds of
favorable columnists, radio talk show hosts, and editorial
writers nationwide who can help mobilize public opinion;
*** Deploy digital advertising through email
and across social media in the days before the vote to really
make Congress feel the heat; and
*** Run TV and radio ads targeting swing
votes in key states and districts.
It is critical in this battle that Congress
hears loud and clear from the nearly 80% of Americans who support
Right to Work.

Of course, Congress may choose to obey Big
Labor bosses rather than the majority of their constituents.
That's their choice.

But time and again, when politicians defied
the public and voted for forced unionism, they've paid the price
with the end of their political careers!

Of course, this whole effort will be very
expensive.

An all-out media and direct-mail blitz to
mobilize massive public pressure on Congress will be the key to
our success.

To pay for the expensive ads, mailings, and
other efforts, it's urgent you send a special contribution to the
National Right to Work Committee today.

Will you make a generous contribution of
$1,000, $500, $250, $100, or $50 to launch the next, crucial
phase for ultimate passage of a National Right to Work law?

It's vital you act immediately to put the
politicians' feet to the fire to bring the National Right to Work
Act up for a vote.

It would be a crime to let politicians who
support compulsory unionism off the hook.

Up against the forced-dues fed,
billion-dollar might of Big Labor, all the Committee has on its
side is truth, public opinion. . .

. . . and you!

Unlike Big Labor, the National Right to Work
Committee doesn't have (or want) the power to force anyone to pay
dues.

So it has to depend on generous folks like
you.

Please don't make it easy for Chuck Schumer,
Hakeem Jeffries, Joe Biden, and Big Labor to bury the National
Right to Work Bill.

Some folks have already sent $500, $1,000,
and even more. For others, a contribution of $50 or $100 has been
as much as they could afford.

Please submit your petition so we can
demonstrate to Congress and the media the strong support for
Right to Work.

Without your contribution of $1,000, $500,
$250, $100, or $50, the National Right to Work Committee won't be
able to contact 10 million Americans, place the advertising,
deploy the whole digital program, or do anything else to put Big
Labor on the spot with a public vote on the National Right to
Work Bill.

And if you and I don't press forward now, we
may never have a chance like this again.

Please help today.

Be sure to submit your petition to Senate
Minority Leader Mitch McConnell, House Speaker Mike Johnson, your
Senators, and Congressman, and then give your contribution of
$1,000, $500, $250, $100, or $50 to the National Right to Work
Committee.

Sincerely,

Rand Paul
United States Senator

P.S. Since most Americans oppose Big Labor's
forced-unionism powers, a public debate on my National Right to
Work Bill is Big Labor's (and their water-carriers' in Congress)
worst nightmare!

So please, submit your petition to Congress,
and then pitch in with your contribution of $500, $250, $100, or
$50 to the National Right to Work Committee today.

The National Right to Work Committee is a
nonprofit, nonpartisan, single-purpose citizens' organization
dedicated to combating compulsory unionism through an aggressive
program designed to mobilize public opposition to compulsory
unionism and, at the same time, enlist public support for Right
to Work legislation. The Committee's mailing address is 8001
Braddock Road, Springfield, Virginia 22160. The Committee can be
contacted toll-free at 1-800-325-7892. Its web address is
www.nrtwc.org

Not produced or e-mailed at taxpayer expense.

To help the National Right to Work Committee
grow, please forward this to a friend.

subject: We must save ourselves and become the leaders we don’t have.

body:
The Republic we learned about in school has been taken hostage by a tyrannical minority of politicians and lobbyists.
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfc4ec9c5-b4bd-4ead-8c26-2af2c864e72e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | Peter, This is going to be a longer email, but it’s really important. I hope you’ll take a couple minutes to read. I want to talk about the huge challenges facing our democracy. [**But if you don’t have the time to read and you still want to make a donation to help Leaders We Deserve elect more young people who are committed to addressing those challenges, you can click here to pitch in right now.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T75019497-2696-4c62-8f6a-f0c9413c8d98/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Today, the Republic we learned about in school has been taken hostage by a tyrannical minority of politicians and lobbyists who have pledged allegiance to the powerful, not the people. They act to placate special interests that are destroying our planet, endangering our schools, and seeking to tighten their stranglehold on our suffocating democracy — all in the name of profit. Young Americans have grown up witnessing this. Previous generations saw the horrors of war, racial injustice, and the assassination of our greatest leaders broadcast into their homes on TV. In contrast, we hold in our hands—on our phones—the horror of school shootings, attempted insurrections, hate crimes like those in Buffalo, El Paso, and too many others, as well as the wrath of climate change. Yet, like our forebears, we refuse to accept that the America we were born into is the best we can achieve. We’ve protested by the millions, leading walkouts and marches to demand action on gun violence in every community, and we’ve staged sit-ins for climate action, demanding police accountability for the extrajudicial killings of our fellow Americans. Young Americans have also voted at the highest rates in our history over the past three elections. We do so because we believe, contrary to what Fox News tells our grandparents, that America's best days lie ahead, not behind us. We know that our democracy is broken, but it’s not unfixable. **We also know that no one else will come to save us — we must save ourselves and become the leaders we don’t have.** I believe the greatest threat to our democracy is not a single individual, such as Donald Trump. **The real danger is the hopelessness** that elevates such figures and the failure of our government to deliver for its people, fueling that despair. It's concerning to see an increasing number of Americans, both young and old, yearning for "one good politician who's not corrupt to come and fix it all," not realizing that such a day could herald the rise of a dictator. Gen Z has been educated about democracy in our civics classes while simultaneously preparing for active shooter drills, reflecting a democracy that has failed to ensure our safety. **If we don't address this and empower more young people who understand the anxiety of these drills and who can inject much-needed hope into our democracy, we risk losing it altogether.** If our democracy fails to fulfill our most basic expectations — keeping us safe — voters may turn to someone who promises security while endangering democracy itself. **That’s why I co-founded Leaders We Deserve.** We are striving to elect young leaders who believe our country's best days are ahead, who envision a government that truly serves its people, understanding that poor governance is a result of poor leadership. For too long, many politicians have been propped up by special interests who claim government doesn't work, only to be elected and ensure its failure. That’s one of the biggest reasons we refuse to accept corporate money, relying instead on the vast majority of our funds from small donors. We help recruit, staff, substantially fund and provide volunteers for the campaigns of young Democrats under 30 running for state legislatures and Congress. If we can change the face of our government and elect more young leaders who understand the gravity of the problems we’re facing, we may finally be able to make the progress we need to overcome them. But the work we’re doing takes a lot of resources, Peter, and we’re counting on your support to keep going. [**So if you’re with us in the fight to ensure our democracy survives for future generations, and if you’re able, please pitch in $10 to support our efforts today.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6e0bec50-e651-4d58-b78d-bb35cb943dfe/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country.

| | Friend, Throughout the United States, Catholic schools are __**_instrumental_** in reigniting students' and communities' passion for learning. Whether it's the strong academic foundation offered by urban Catholic schools or the fundamental education accessible through new classical Catholic schools, Catholic education holds a profound intellectual and spiritual legacy for students and their families.
In many communities, Catholic schools are the sole option for families seeking a robust educational foundation for their children. **[Sadly, financial challenges are leading many Catholic schools to close their doors, leaving families with limited alternatives.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0IwuKi6ZtNYz0f1z62JLug~~/AARclAA~/RgRnZq_6P0RMaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS8wODZjMmY1Ni1kMGZiLTQ4NjctOGY4MS02NmRiMjZhZjMyODIvcGV0aXRpb24tMTAwM1cDc3BjQgplg5QJhGXBnp74UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

subject: CTA Dec. 21: Act NOW to protect American energy & farmland
body:

---
| | The safety of America’s natural resources held on public lands are at risk because of a proposed rule change put out by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). We are writing today to ask you to light up the Capitol Switchboard on this issue! On October 4, 2023, the SEC [published a proposed rule](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjpudWxsLCJycSI6IjAyLWIyMzM1NS05ZjUzMTI4ZDhjMTk0NjMxYWQ2NDE2YjU4MjZjNDg4MCIsInBoIjpudWxsLCJtIjpmYWxzZSwidWkiOiIwIiwidW4iOiIiLCJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ292aW5mby5nb3YvY29udGVudC9wa2cvRlItMjAyMy0xMC0wNC9wZGYvMjAyMy0yMjA0MS5wZGY_bWlkPTQ2NTkxJmlkPVQxN1VOVHNmWkp0d2tTeVRUQyJ9/1aY7C276pT_GGF1KPzLxMA) that would create an entirely new type of company called a Natural Asset Company (NAC). According to the proposed rule, a NAC "is a corporation whose primary purpose is to actively manage, maintain, restore (as applicable), and grow the value of natural assets and their production of ecosystem services." Under this rule, these NACs would have authority to limit, control, and oversee any activities on public lands that they deem harmful to the ecosystem. Marlo Oaks, the State Treasurer of Utah, said in a Wall Street Journal article, "If the rule stands, productive farmland could disappear rapidly. Energy self-sufficiency will soon be lost forever. One of America's greatest assets, her natural resources, would be diminished due to climate catastrophizing, complicit politicians, and Wall Street promoters." In response to this, Congresswoman Harriet Hageman (R-WY) is circulating a member letter requesting an extension of the comment period for the proposed rule. **ACTION****[Call your member](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjpudWxsLCJycSI6IjAyLWIyMzM1NS05ZjUzMTI4ZDhjMTk0NjMxYWQ2NDE2YjU4MjZjNDg4MCIsInBoIjpudWxsLCJtIjpmYWxzZSwidWkiOiIxIiwidW4iOiIiLCJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaG91c2UuZ292L3JlcHJlc2VudGF0aXZlcy9maW5kLXlvdXItcmVwcmVzZW50YXRpdmU_bWlkPTQ2NTkxJmlkPVQxN1VOVHNmWkp0d2tTeVRUQyJ9/ddiaF6BIn0NGU4ghYNtNAQ) and ask them to sign Rep. Hageman's letter requesting the SEC to extend the comment period for another 60 days.**

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=b912a8c6415f432993a7397d064b6050&_e=po8Qcr8LTxjQS9VZO5GOBJvKFWI3nXyovIBXsTGUsMLvxjW9FRpD3ArhMzpguq6WU33mRNJjP3kV0rWjQBbqQ4ShZePCyHAgm5Ym5BNIjpCT-N9bFs3S0H3i1QdN2qmXym7ldcEf4nLF6fer63nBTzEJoWobFRv1vPy5tARz1B63EQ4pOHeKIn5jWoXofMYaR9N8XkdI33F1NUOnbw9fjxP3Ai-gsZzOMDL8dc1m36ipAPlzB5eRxsnnMmBDLHPaKQ-CgvnbU9VjhQls3d-S3d6jGyiPu1o5eUxcRA5lpGQrtdarTQj-uBBjoz54WI81iXgyUnsMl6tfkojy43U3bqvr-b-2BtIIslxOZ_dDlPQ%3D)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:
* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=b912a8c6415f432993a7397d064b6050&_e=po8Qcr8LTxjQS9VZO5GOBJvKFWI3nXyovIBXsTGUsMLvxjW9FRpD3ArhMzpguq6WU33mRNJjP3kV0rWjQBbqQ4ShZePCyHAgm5Ym5BNIjpCT-N9bFs3S0H3i1QdN2qmXym7ldcEf4nLF6fer63nBTzEJoWobFRv1vPy5tARz1B63EQ4pOHeKIn5jWoXofMYaR9N8XkdI33F1NUOnbw9fj8bsEn-itvdEzoHS8bYgF6yul4JTV0SZZpo05VHzcgv8MuX7xr9xfoRKwFDJSgUB-Xf2ZFYtY2PdBPl4Frz3mYfXiY9D19oodQmkPsk72H7gUtx3KLa47H0zI4yue5HkoFG2Lmce5P4Tgg7VoFxgpMM%3D)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

Hey friend,

I know you might not be able to see all that's going on out here on the trail, so I thought it was time I send you over an update from the ground! We're working hard, and it's paying off every day.

In preparation for the Iowa Caucus, we're spending time with my good friend Governor Kim Reynolds and reaching as many Iowans as we can. Our mission is to earn the commitment of the people of Iowa to caucus for us on January 15th. So far, we've earned the commitment of tens of thousands of Iowans and we're adding more every single day.

I know my team reached out about this, but at the beginning of this month, I wrapped up my tour of all 99 counties in the state and I can tell you... there is nothing like being able to prove that you're a servant to the American people, not a ruler.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=fe15ba36fe7d8bce44a7b902c2d1b30a3bbe4c0f30be64cc52fcd908b108ffc3d24d9834d500673f9f4848f03d47964c704583202805be5b9f3eb56386db6554

Taking questions, talking about the real issues, meeting and hearing the voices of true Americans fighting to save our country. That's been the honor of my life. And it's what I'll be doing in every state after we win in Iowa!

We've got a head of steam and we can't wait to keep moving forward. I hope to meet you out on the trail next, friend.

And from the bottom of my heart, thank you for being on my team.

Sincerely,

Heads up! We have pre-checked the monthly donor box on our fundraising page. Monthly donors make a HUGE difference for our team and help ups plan ahead.

If one donation was all it took to defeat Joe Biden next November then we wouldn't ask for your help more than we already have, but unfortunately it's going to take more than that to win.

Please keep this box checked so we that we can count on your support.

Volunteer!

We welcome you to join Team DeSantis by volunteering to spread our message: Decline is a choice. Success is attainable. And freedom is worth fighting for.

Help us lead our Great American Comeback by getting involved today!

Sign up here!

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=fe15ba36fe7d8bce44a7b902c2d1b30a3bbe4c0f30be64cc52fcd908b108ffc3d24d9834d500673f9f4848f03d47964c704583202805be5b9f3eb56386db6554

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=fe15ba36fe7d8bce44a7b902c2d1b30a3bbe4c0f30be64cc52fcd908b108ffc3d24d9834d500673f9f4848f03d47964c704583202805be5b9f3eb56386db6554

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

body:
West Michigan deserves representation that reflects the best of us. Someone they can trust that embodies their values. | | | | |
---
***|FNAME|*,** Today’s politicians sow doubt, fear, anger in our communities. They promise unity and progress yet deliver division and the status quo.
We are fortunate enough to live in the greatest country in the world and it’s about time our leaders represent and bring out the best of us, not the worst.Americans deserve an economy that works, a government that doesn’t waste their hard earned money, the freedom to make their own decisions, and safe communities.
These expectations aren’t being met and that’s why I’m running to represent West Michigan in Congress.
| | | | | | | | |
---
As a pragmatic and principled Republican, I am is focused on finding common-sense solutions to the problems that face West Michigan and our Nation.With the extremes in our two-party system threatening to pull our country off course, I believe we need a return to sound conservative principles to get us back in the right direction. My policy platform focuses on three key areas: Growth, Prosperity, & Security
| [DONATE](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=72ca4b9fe2&e=26f66c7cbd)
---
| | | | | | | | |
# Growth
Unlock economic growth through free markets; lower taxes, less regulation, and fiscal responsibility to rein in runaway inflation and exploding national debt.
---
|
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
# Prosperity
A pro-growth agenda will unleash broad-based prosperity, improve quality of life for all, and allow us to strategically invest in our future.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | |
# Security
Our American way of life is not possible without a commitment to security, both at home and abroad: Strong national defense, steely-eyed leadership on the world stage, and steady enforcement of the law in our cities & on the border.
---
|
---
|
---
We need change. I reject the idea that we’re a nation in decline, and believe we are still the greatest country on earth, by a wide margin. I believe we need to start acting like it again – to get back to common-sense, common-ground policymaking that works for everyday Americans. I’m exhausted by the empty campaign promises from politicians like Joe Biden and Hillary Scholten about uniting the country and governing from the center, who then turn around and support extreme left-wing proposals and identity politics that further divide the country. The time is now for serious, sensible candidates to chart a new course for West Michigan and the Nation.
|
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| [DONATE](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=c76381218f&e=26f66c7cbd)
---
|
# Support the campaign
Your donations help us spread the message: we want change. If you’re able to donate, please let me express the most sincere thanks.
---
|
---
Thank you for taking the time to learn more about my vision for the future. It’s going to be a long campaign and I very much look forward to learning more about the issues that are impacting you most.
**\- Paul Hudson**

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

Have you had it with the broken two party system in Washington? If so, you’re not alone.
Record numbers of Americans say we’re on the wrong track and want an independent choice for President. In fact, Independent candidate Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s net favorability leads the entire field of the two party presidential candidates by a wide margin.

[DONATE TODAY >> ](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=favor_12_21_23_email_1_rs_2_nd&n=3)

**And where have the two parties in Washington led us recently?**
After the failed policies of the Trump and Biden administrations, the top 1% now owns more wealth than the entire 60% in the middle. The Trump Biden lockdown economy has saddled us with an unacceptable crisis. Working Americans can no longer afford life in America. Americans, on average, are borrowing $5000 a year on credit cards to meet their needs.

assures us that the enemies of Israel will not succeed. And when

join me in prayer by visiting this link:

Thank you
for committing to praying for Israel.
Sharing
the Truth of God's Word,
Dr.

Friend,

Financial strain, left-wing propaganda, exploitation of
children's innocence, the praising of terrorists.

That was America's 2023 under Joe Biden.

This is it... we are facing one choice in 2024: we can either sit
back and let this destruction take our country down, or we can
stand up and do something about it.

Help me fight by chipping in $20.24 today. I need your support.

I
am not okay with letting America slip away or letting the Left
take advantage of YOU. While you're home trying to allocate money
to spend on making the holidays special for your family, Jill and
Joe Biden are taking your tax dollars and throwing them at
radical activist groups to parade through the halls that leaders
like Ronald Reagan used to march through.

There is truly no clearer picture of our country's decline than
the dereliction of duty by our President. Let me be clear:

Your job as President is to put the interests of the people you
serve above all else and protect them at all costs. Do you think
ignoring the cries of Americans fulfills that duty? As their
cities are overrun due to a wide-open border, their kids are
brainwashed in their classrooms, and they can't afford groceries
to put food on the table?

Joe
Biden must either believe this is acceptable, or he has no idea
what's going on. I'm here to tell you- I see you, I hear you, I
will never stop fighting for you, and I will make you proud doing
it.

future. If you can chip in to my campaign, I am humbly asking you
to before we approach the biggest fundraising deadline we've hit

will not let you down. But if you can afford it, I need your help

Ron DeSantis comes from
blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to
him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the
Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate
degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was
so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered
to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a
life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and
now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting
to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in
this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every
turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and
consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his
life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and
3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that
this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents
face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political
agenda down the throats of children.

promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected
bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to
children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by
immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our
southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the
mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring
our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on
track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record
speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment,
politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the
legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his
leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has
stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next
President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill
for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for
President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the
decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for
another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act
is now.

clean_body: Fair Fight is working every day to make sure people can use their power in our democracy — but we need this grassroots team | | | Right-wing activists are sifting through voter registration lists to question their fellow American citizens’ qualifications to vote. It’s a grassroots effort to purge the nation's registration rolls ahead of the 2024 elections. CBS News recently reported on how more than 80,000 challenges have been filed against voters in Georgia alone since 2021: "Georgia became ground zero for the movement after Republicans in the state pushed through a law in 2021 allowing citizens to file an unlimited number of challenges against fellow voters within their own county." It’s a blatant ploy to prevent voters — especially young voters, people of color, and unhoused folks — from having their voices heard. We won’t stand by and let that happen. National media coverage puts urgent issues in front of the public and key allies — so our Communications, Voter Protection, and Organizing teams facilitated conversations between the CBS News reporters and voters and elections officials quoted in the story. body:
Gun violence is the LEADING cause of death for children in our nation. Not car crashes. Not cancer. Guns.
#

Friends -
The CDC just released new data showing a horrifying trend that children are often unintentionally killed because of unsecured firearms. Overwhelmingly, firearms in these accidental shootings are unstored and unlocked.
Gun violence is the LEADING cause of death for children in our nation. Not car crashes. Not cancer. Guns.
This is a devastating, unacceptable fact. It’s long past time for leaders in every community across our nation to pass and implement safe storage laws to protect our children from accidental shootings.
[**Will you sign our petition today to show your support for commonsense gun safety measures like safe storage laws to help protect our children?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_safestoragedec23/?source=em231221-1-30&refcode2=7072.3935704.Qn-bd1&akid=7072%2E3935704%2EQn-bd1)

We appreciate you taking the time to use your voice. We must work together to keep guns out of children’s hands.
\- The team at GIFFORDS

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
With the holidays approaching, I want to take a minute to thank you for all your support and remind you that the final Federal Election Commission (FEC) deadline of 2023 is a little more than a week away, on New Year’s Eve. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231221?refcode=lpfe231221]
As you know, we file a finance report with the FEC at the end of each quarter, demonstrating the strength of support for our campaign. https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231221?refcode=lpfe231221 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231221?refcode=lpfe231221]
We always want a strong report—especially as we head into 2024—because a good report reflects not only on the strength of our campaign but also our ability to turn out the vote in Texas and take back the House in Washington. I’m keeping a close eye on our numbers to ensure we’re on track to reaching our goal and have the resources we need to run a strong campaign in the 11 weeks before the Texas primary.
If you’re able to contribute before you head out for the holidays, it’d be greatly appreciated. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe231130?refcode=lpfe231130]
Thank you for your support!
Gordon
Gordon Center
Campaign Treasurer

He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

Peter,

This is going to be a longer email, but it’s really important. I hope you’ll take a couple minutes to read. I want to talk about the huge challenges facing our democracy.

**[But if you don’t have the time to read and you still want to make a donation to help Leaders We Deserve elect more young people who are committed to addressing those challenges, you can click here to pitch in right now.](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953z13Gsiw4jYjb8npbjGXirZ0ILxIMA_3jJWmaUJ_ODE2QdvaesRlMZG-owbL8qLNeIfpmhSv3jbSyVU4TS4bnnimXTEcnMb5VKqPfeW3A9W2dOyujeUk6p5-LLMjL26gTNweR6aW9JH8TgE3_83STI7ifg7wWOlqLERxOs2gn7dqnQ0H8rbTjlnbcR3_xGev_hInM2yKJ5dAO3C6jl1RqGDIcS3g2bVzqy4QYygM21NZ7P95gdcbFxxY9-DKvuQM7IhTpaTGdzhDUmc83pqNQ8xWyLznhBl1gHxAxd4l95OmsPtDYN-ET88Ucyd5qdi3theGPPZ2LyeGCeTxuihYa_ARSUVSwDwocQtuXa7Il2lWP0YQi472T0PJYKoIK5dxoY/42b/sLFmtqabQYy-aAWbnnjxVQ/h2/3VcUp3e5WOIvzqsm_ij8s48UadkT83Q_9gttS5UVFiE)**

Today, the Republic we learned about in school has been taken hostage by a tyrannical minority of politicians and lobbyists who have pledged allegiance to the powerful, not the people. They act to placate special interests that are destroying our planet, endangering our schools, and seeking to tighten their stranglehold on our suffocating democracy — all in the name of profit.

Young Americans have grown up witnessing this. Previous generations saw the horrors of war, racial injustice, and the assassination of our greatest leaders broadcast into their homes on TV. In contrast, we hold in our hands—on our phones—the horror of school shootings, attempted insurrections, hate crimes like those in Buffalo, El Paso, and too many others, as well as the wrath of climate change.

Yet, like our forebears, we refuse to accept that the America we were born into is the best we can achieve. We’ve protested by the millions, leading walkouts and marches to demand action on gun violence in every community, and we’ve staged sit-ins for climate action, demanding police accountability for the extrajudicial killings of our fellow Americans.

Young Americans have also voted at the highest rates in our history over the past three elections. We do so because we believe, contrary to what Fox News tells our grandparents, that America's best days lie ahead, not behind us. We know that our democracy is broken, but it’s not unfixable. **We also know that no one else will come to save us — we must save ourselves and become the leaders we don’t have.**

I believe the greatest threat to our democracy is not a single individual, such as Donald Trump. **The real danger is the hopelessness** that elevates such figures and the failure of our government to deliver for its people, fueling that despair. It's concerning to see an increasing number of Americans, both young and old, yearning for "one good politician who's not corrupt to come and fix it all," not realizing that such a day could herald the rise of a dictator.

Gen Z has been educated about democracy in our civics classes while simultaneously preparing for active shooter drills, reflecting a democracy that has failed to ensure our safety. **If we don't address this and empower more young people who understand the anxiety of these drills and who can inject much-needed hope into our democracy, we risk losing it altogether.** If our democracy fails to fulfill our most basic expectations — keeping us safe — voters may turn to someone who promises security while endangering democracy itself.

**That’s why I co-founded Leaders We Deserve.** We are striving to elect young leaders who believe our country's best days are ahead, who envision a government that truly serves its people, understanding that poor governance is a result of poor leadership. For too long, many politicians have been propped up by special interests who claim government doesn't work, only to be elected and ensure its failure.

That’s one of the biggest reasons we refuse to accept corporate money, relying instead on the vast majority of our funds from small donors. We help recruit, staff, substantially fund and provide volunteers for the campaigns of young Democrats under 30 running for state legislatures and Congress.

If we can change the face of our government and elect more young leaders who understand the gravity of the problems we’re facing, we may finally be able to make the progress we need to overcome them. But the work we’re doing takes a lot of resources, Firstname, and we’re counting on your support to keep going.

**[So if you’re with us in the fight to ensure our democracy survives for future generations, and if you’re able, please pitch in $10 to support our efforts today.](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953z13Gsiw4jYjb8npbjGXirZ0ILxIMA_3jJWmaUJ_ODE2QdvaesRlMZG-owbL8qLNeIfpmhSv3jbSyVU4TS4bnnimXTEcnMb5VKqPfeW3A9W2dOyujeUk6p5-LLMjL26gTOGrk7UOq1l68uFzfB0SLm0OQf_dkp5zw_CWyZ1IgtZlCq5CDcTOaz3aXs1R01bF-Dpi61aHG64M1qMv8huwJ0F4_kI0hqjliZyOVaIjmd2rxLgyhySs1gsxMcArNIw6tKoxGSZ2JKF5VL9Jh-HsXRRD4YSSq3-DaSOVSqR94uQEkrGK57ju6SpvB-vNGsp_k239x2UIwLpKpj7fr5r9Dv8brO_CSo2ZuXEFBgR5alZnh9fFJ5W4GZMLjyJrHFk2IQ/42b/sLFmtqabQYy-aAWbnnjxVQ/h3/L9J_25eQrr4GiDjgNoC4YeQB1ldK-5th0ly8bfnw0Ok)** | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately and split between Leaders We Deserve and The Collective PAC.

clean_body: The Republic we learned about in school has been taken hostage by a tyrannical minority of politicians and lobbyists. | | If you want to help The Collective PAC build Black political power up and down the ballot, and across the country, then you’re in the right place. If you'd like to unsubscribe | | Peter, This is going to be a longer email, but it’s really important. I hope you’ll take a couple minutes to read. I want to talk about the huge challenges facing our democracy. Today, the Republic we learned about in school has been taken hostage by a tyrannical minority of politicians and lobbyists who have pledged allegiance to the powerful, not the people. They act to placate special interests that are destroying our planet, endangering our schools, and seeking to tighten their stranglehold on our suffocating democracy — all in the name of profit. Young Americans have grown up witnessing this. Previous generations saw the horrors of war, racial injustice, and the assassination of our greatest leaders broadcast into their homes on TV. In contrast, we hold in our hands—on our phones—the horror of school shootings, attempted insurrections, hate crimes like those in Buffalo, El Paso, and too many others, as well as the wrath of climate change. Yet, like our forebears, we refuse to accept that the America we were born into is the best we can achieve. We’ve protested by the millions, leading walkouts and marches to demand action on gun violence in every community, and we’ve staged sit-ins for climate action, demanding police accountability for the extrajudicial killings of our fellow Americans. Young Americans have also voted at the highest rates in our history over the past three elections. We do so because we believe, contrary to what Fox News tells our grandparents, that America's best days lie ahead, not behind us. We know that our democracy is broken, but it’s not unfixable. We also know that no one else will come to save us — we must save ourselves and become the leaders we don’t have. I believe the greatest threat to our democracy is not a single individual, such as Donald Trump. The real danger is the hopelessness that elevates such figures and the failure of our government to deliver for its people, fueling that despair. It's concerning to see an increasing number of Americans, both young and old, yearning for "one good politician who's not corrupt to come and fix it all," not realizing that such a day could herald the rise of a dictator. Gen Z has been educated about democracy in our civics classes while simultaneously preparing for active shooter drills, reflecting a democracy that has failed to ensure our safety. If we don't address this and empower more young people who understand the anxiety of these drills and who can inject much-needed hope into our democracy, we risk losing it altogether. If our democracy fails to fulfill our most basic expectations — keeping us safe — voters may turn to someone who promises security while endangering democracy itself. That’s why I co-founded Leaders We Deserve. We are striving to elect young leaders who believe our country's best days are ahead, who envision a government that truly serves its people, understanding that poor governance is a result of poor leadership. For too long, many politicians have been propped up by special interests who claim government doesn't work, only to be elected and ensure its failure. That’s one of the biggest reasons we refuse to accept corporate money, relying instead on the vast majority of our funds from small donors. We help recruit, staff, substantially fund and provide volunteers for the campaigns of young Democrats under 30 running for state legislatures and Congress. If we can change the face of our government and elect more young leaders who understand the gravity of the problems we’re facing, we may finally be able to make the progress we need to overcome them.
