name: ElissaSlotkin.org
subject: GOP’s most recent abortion attacks
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=942%2E135344%2EEvU6Cr)

Friend,
The last few weeks have shown us clear as day that, a year and a half after the overturning of Roe v. Wade, abortion rights remain under attack. In Texas, the entire country watched in horror as a pregnant woman with a terminally ill fetus was forced by a group of judges to leave the state to terminate the pregnancy, in the hopes of going on to have children.
This week, after nearly a year of delays, GOP Senator Tommy Tuberville finally gave up his bid to stop all women serving in the military from being granted leave to travel for an abortion. He held up over 400 senior military confirmations AND virtually no Republicans said anything to defend the rights of servicewomen.
In D.C. last week, Republicans succeeded in taking a case to the SCOTUS to ban the mailing of Mifepristone across state lines, a safe and legal drug that has been widely used for over two decades for women having miscarriages, D&Cs;, medically necessary terminations and abortions. This case could ban the mailing of the drug even to blue states, making it extremely difficult to get an abortion, even where it’s legal. For the 1 in 4 women who miscarry, this is the most common way to safely get them through the process.
These salami tactics put in plain view what we have already known: For Republicans, it was never just about Roe. If this Republican party is allowed to take the White House and the Senate, they will try to ban abortion from every angle at the federal level. They will not stop when states like Michigan and Kansas and California and Kentucky and Ohio organize and vote to codify protections for women. Sure, they might change their talking points to make it sound like they support access to abortion, but it’s a deception: They want an abortion ban, and they will simply bend to the will of the extremists of their party and vote for it.
Here in Michigan, all four of the serious Republican candidates in this race have proven extreme positions on abortion:
* Former Congressman Mike Rogers repeatedly voted for an abortion ban even in the cases of rape, incest, and common miscarriage. He now claims he wouldn’t oppose abortion in Michigan, but his actions are a lot louder than his (now) words.
* Former Detroit Police Chief James Craig opposes all abortion, including for victims of rape and incest. In his last campaign, he confirmed that he would work to keep Michigan’s 1931 abortion ban.
* Former Congressman Peter Meijer has campaigned on being “100% pro-life” even in cases of rape or incest, and supported a federal ban on abortion – until he realized he wanted to be elected statewide.
* Businessman Sandy Pensler says he is “a pro-life conservative”; called Roe v. Wade a “terrible decision,” and claimed that Prop 3 in Michigan, which protected the right to choose in Michigan’s Constitution, “went too far.”

We’ll be frank: Our best line of defense against these attacks on reproductive healthcare at the federal level is to ensure Democrats maintain control of the White House and the Senate – and to elect Senators who will vote to end the filibuster as we know it so we can codify Roe into federal law, as we’ve done in the House.
But public polling has made it clear that the path to do so will hinge on what happens right here in Michigan. With both our race for Senate and the Presidential race at a statistical dead-heat, we can’t take anything for granted. [**That’s why we’re asking: Will you chip in $3 now to help push back on attacks on choice, keep Michigan blue, and send Elissa to the U.S. Senate?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231221-1-tt&t=2&akid=942%2E135344%2EEvU6Cr) **[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231221-1-tt&t=3&akid=942%2E135344%2EEvU6Cr)**
Thank you,
Team Slotkin

PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
P.O. Box 4145
East Lansing, MI 48826
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can [ unsubscribe here](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=4&akid=942%2E135344%2EEvU6Cr).

Derek,
My friend Bob Casey is Pennsylvania through and through -- and I’m proud to stand up for working people + PA families alongside him in the Senate.
**But Connecticut-based mega-millionaire David McCormick (remember him?) is running against Bob -- and the GOP are doing everything they can to flip PA red in 2024. 😧**

Peter, I never saw myself running for office. But with Emerge’s programs and support, I became the first out-and-seated transgender state legislator in American history by defeating a 13-term GOP incumbent who proudly called himself Virginia’s “chief homophobe.” Now, I’m part of a movement of Democratic women transforming politics all across the United States. And with all our rights on the line in the 2024 elections, I’m reaching out to ask you to be a part of it, too.
This year’s wins in Virginia were made possible by Emerge alums like me. **Holding the Virginia state Senate and flipping the House of Delegates back to blue were Emerge victories.** But to get those results and set the pace for the crucial races ahead, we had to build a strong bench of Democratic women ready to run at this decisive moment. That’s the work that Emerge is doing every day – state by state – to defeat the far-right’s agenda and protect our rights for decades to come.
**I’m asking you to support Emerge with an urgent donation today because empowering more Democratic women is how we build blue majorities at every level and change the face of politics once and for all. subject: Religious liberty is on the line
body:
You have an opportunity to help correct one of the worst injustices of the Covid era.

| |
---
| | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zt4df5jqjdog627ut3k76rp0hur4ptgf95jca6f8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chie4ob4c3h2bs)

Friend, You have an opportunity to help correct one of the worst injustices of the Covid era. **Thou****sands of hardworking, competent people were fired –– all because they refused to get the Covid shot.** Doctors, nurses, teachers, members of the military, and many more. It’s the natural tendency of the authoritarian left to punish people for refusing to go along with its schemes. And now that we know more of the truth about Covid, the vaccine, and the shady collusion between government organizations, Big Tech and Big Pharma......they’d love nothing more than to sweep this all under the rug and pretend it never happened. **That’s why I’ve instructed our attorneys at the Center for American Liberty to initiate legal action to hold them accountable.** For starters, we filed a lawsuit against the North Carolina Symphony on behalf of three musicians fired for refusing to get the COVID vaccine._Each of them had been in the Symphony for over a decade._ **[**And if we can win this critical legal battle, we can put employers across the country on notice that they should reinstate victims of their COVID vaccine firings.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z40eelk479cntu6g40btnv5qaif4j5e7jehukc78_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chie4ob4c3h2bs)** When the Symphony introduced their vaccine mandate, it offered both religious and medical exemptions.Dovid, Chris, and Rachel each held sincere religious beliefs, filed for exemptions, and expressed a willingness to take other measures—like regular COVID testing—to ensure safety.But the Symphony rejected ALL of them and put them on a year of UNPAID LEAVE. These three musicians were Buddhist, Christian and Jewish.**To you and me, the freedom to practice your religion is a sacred right.****So is your right to bodily autonomy.** But in the eyes of the cultural Marxists who control so many institutions in America today, your body doesn’t belong to you – it belongs to them.They’ll decide where you go... They’ll decide what you need... They’ll decide what you can have... They’ll decide what vaccines you must take...In other words: _Your individual liberties_ will cease to exist. The good news is that while cultural Marxism is popular on college campuses, legacy media press rooms, the boardrooms of woke companies and inside government bureaucracies......the vast majority of Americans are against it. This is a fight we can win – and we must win. **[**You can join me today by making a generous, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty to fund this lawsuit for medical and religious freedom, and set a precedent nationwide that puts these radicals on notice.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zboh2lb159g62277ubea0vgcq5sjl2k461mp2dv0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chie4ob4c3h2bs)** Even after the North Carolina Symphony lifted its vaccine mandate, it refused to give these musicians their jobs back.Because it was never about “science” or “health” – it was always about control.And it’s time to tell the cultural Marxists who want to control every aspect of your life that we aren’t backing down.I hope I can count on your support.

| | Friend, As we get closer to the end of 2023, we want to thank you for all of your support over the past year. We’ve been able to launch a youth organizing initiative, push for legislation to combat big money in politics, and work to reform the Supreme Court after years of dangerous corruption. We couldn’t have done it without you.This year: • We launched a brand new youth organizing initiative in New York, setting the stage for more young people than ever to get involved in New York politics.• We fought against corruption on the Supreme Court, slamming the sham Code of Conduct and pushing for the _Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal, and Transparency (SCERT) Act._ • We called out No Labels, a group that says they’re for the “commonsense majority” but is really a way for rightwing megadonors to advocate for corporations and special interests. • We continued to protect our democracy and get Big Money out of politics by advocating for pro-democracy legislation. But we still have a lot of work to do next year. This year showed the scope of the corruption that plagues Congress and the Supreme Court. And it’s clear that the threats to our democracy are still pervasive and dangerous. **[There are warning signs everywhere about the decline of our democracy - from voter suppression to corruption on the highest Court in the land - it’s imperative that we have all hands on deck to make sure that democracy continues to triumph and stop big money’s impact on our elections. Can you chip in $10 so we can keep working towards free and fair elections?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75575447/445108189/444630146?refcode=12-21-23&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFmNGE4YjE3LTFiYTAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FhLHYhuIu10GXaYTT40DqTytsFEDbZ2q77neJg9Gyxo=)** We’ve seen the dangers of corruption and big money over the past year. From bribing Supreme Court Justices to spending campaign funds on botox and porn, the corruption we’re seeing in our government is out of control. Next year will be instrumental in protecting American democracy and freeing our elections from the clutches of dark money and mega donors, and we’re gearing up for a fight. We’re prepared to fight against corruption in all its forms, all across the country. **[The work we did this year set the stage for what we plan to do in 2024, but we need you on board with our plans. If you care about fighting against corruption and big money’s influence in politics, please contribute $10 so we can keep up our work.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75575448/445108190/444630146?refcode=12-21-23&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFmNGE4YjE3LTFiYTAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FhLHYhuIu10GXaYTT40DqTytsFEDbZ2q77neJg9Gyxo=)** Thank you,— Team ECU/LAV Action

body:
You have an opportunity to help correct one of the worst injustices of the Covid era.

| |

Friend, You have an opportunity to help correct one of the worst injustices of the Covid era. **Thou****sands of hardworking, competent people were fired –– all because they refused to get the Covid shot.** Doctors, nurses, teachers, members of the military, and many more. It’s the natural tendency of the authoritarian left to punish people for refusing to go along with its schemes. And now that we know more of the truth about Covid, the vaccine, and the shady collusion between government organizations, Big Tech and Big Pharma......they’d love nothing more than to sweep this all under the rug and pretend it never happened. **That’s why I’ve instructed our attorneys at the Center for American Liberty to initiate legal action to hold them accountable.** For starters, we filed a lawsuit against the North Carolina Symphony on behalf of three musicians fired for refusing to get the COVID vaccine._Each of them had been in the Symphony for over a decade._ **[**And if we can win this critical legal battle, we can put employers across the country on notice that they should reinstate victims of their COVID vaccine firings.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zfevk59gfbqnvavunk4n5ph7g29o9dv823fumbf0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chie4ob4c3h2bs)** When the Symphony introduced their vaccine mandate, it offered both religious and medical exemptions.Dovid, Chris, and Rachel each held sincere religious beliefs, filed for exemptions, and expressed a willingness to take other measures—like regular COVID testing—to ensure safety.But the Symphony rejected ALL of them and put them on a year of UNPAID LEAVE. These three musicians were Buddhist, Christian and Jewish.**To you and me, the freedom to practice your religion is a sacred right.****So is your right to bodily autonomy.** But in the eyes of the cultural Marxists who control so many institutions in America today, your body doesn’t belong to you – it belongs to them.They’ll decide where you go... They’ll decide what you need... They’ll decide what you can have... They’ll decide what vaccines you must take...In other words: _Your individual liberties_ will cease to exist. The good news is that while cultural Marxism is popular on college campuses, legacy media press rooms, the boardrooms of woke companies and inside government bureaucracies......the vast majority of Americans are against it. This is a fight we can win – and we must win. **[**You can join me today by making a generous, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty to fund this lawsuit for medical and religious freedom, and set a precedent nationwide that puts these radicals on notice.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7hrg2q0ivclk133j08322o2c29e5mgo8gjcuung_rp22sh2s8i6eo36chie4ob4c3h2bs)** Even after the North Carolina Symphony lifted its vaccine mandate, it refused to give these musicians their jobs back.Because it was never about “science” or “health” – it was always about control.And it’s time to tell the cultural Marxists who want to control every aspect of your life that we aren’t backing down.I hope I can count on your support.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
Harmeet K. DhillonFounder & CEO

We’ve got some really exciting news to share, neighbors! **The Congressional Progressive Caucus (CPC) just announced their endorsement of Sarah!** In announcing their support, **CPC leaders like Rep. Jamie Raskin** called her a proven changemaker and said "Sarah has been a national inspiration and her leadership is needed in Congress." Anyone who's ever met Sarah knows she's one of the most dedicated elected officials in Delaware. She's worked tirelessly in Dover to deliver economic prosperity for every Delawarean and now the CPC wants to bring her to Congress to do just that. **The CPC joins a long list of dozens of leaders and organizations who've endorsed Sarah’s campaign just 6 months in:**
* Attorney General Kathy Jennings, Insurance Commissioner Trinidad Navarro, State Auditor Lydia York, Former Lt. Governor and Attorney General Matt Denn, and **TWO DOZEN members of the Delaware legislature.**

SkyTree Book Fair and I did a deep dive and discovered the cause of why sexually explicit and disgusting books get into our children's schools, classrooms, and libraries.

Here's what we're up against.

These are books Scholastic promotes at book fairs in schools. Here are pages from "Welcome to St. Hell," a 2022 Scholastic book glamorizing gender transitioning to middle schoolers. (We've censored these pages as the original content could violate social media policies against adult material):

Scholastic holds a virtual monopoly on school book fairs. Like many of our cultural institutions in the last decade, Scholastic has fallen prey to the woke mob and radical LGBT political agenda.

Scholastic promotes this agenda over the well-being of our children.

**Here is the solution:**

SkyTree Book Fair offers schools a different option for book fairs. SkyTree Book Fairs is providing schools, parents, and children with an empowering alternative with literature rooted in truth and family values that matches the quality and ease of Scholastic while countering their harmful agenda.

Here's how you can help.

[I am asking for your urgent support to help SkyTree replace Scholastic in schools. Can you donate $35, $50, or even $100 today toward Sky Tree? We are kicking off with a goal to raise $100,000 this month.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/EYenvJLDuvLy6OsWTaapZw~~/AARclAA~/RgRnZxlUP0Q6aHR0cHM6Ly9za3l0cmVlLWJvb2stZmFpcnMucmV2di5jby9wYS8_dXRtX3RjPVJPTi0yMDIzMTIyMVcDc3BjQgplg_VthGXna617UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)

SkyTree was inspired by my first children's book, As You Grow. Now, I am helping them spread to schools across the country as an alternative to Scholastic. And here's the thing: SkyTree will not only promote age-appropriate books, but they will do so more efficiently to make it easier for schools to choose SkyTree over Scholastic.

And it's working!

SkyTree has already secured its first public school book fair in Spotsylvania, VA!

No more race-infused storylines. No more confusing gender content. Only age-appropriate content that will nurture childhood innocence and character.

SkyTree needs your support today. American children need your support today!!

We are quickly lining up hundreds of new book fairs in the Spring semester. It costs roughly $7,500 to host a book fair. Please help sponsor SkyTree book fairs in schools across the country.

| | | Ron DeSantis' latest draconian law in Florida is an expansion of the "Don't Say Gay" law and has resulted in the removal of 673 books from Orange County classrooms. The new law requires schools to remove "sexual content" from their shelves. The list of banned books includes many classics that have been taught in schools for decades, as well as popular novels. This is a crisis for our education system – Ron DeSantis and other Republicans have waged war on our schools and libraries by preventing kids from learning important topics from diverse perspectives. We can't allow this censorship to continue – we must show strength in numbers by standing with teachers and educators and fighting back against these book bans! Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [] Find your local Registrar's office here: [] [] 15 years of the Community College Access Program at VWCC Learn More [] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs. This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education! CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT [] Karen Jenkins for HB-89 Donate Here [] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia. She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth. Democrats’ Secret Weapon in 2024 [https://www.democracydocket.com/opinion/democrats-secret-weapon-in-2024/]
(Democracy Docket)
Polls for an election a year away drive chatter in some Washington, D.C. circles, but if you get outside of Washington and away from the media’s obsession with Donald Trump and the horse race for the White House, you’ll find Democrats are actually in a position of strength across the country.
Bills would open PA primaries to unaffiliated voters [https://www.publicnewsservice.org/2023-12-14/civic-engagement-and-voting/bills-would-open-pa-primaries-to-unaffiliated-voters/a87279-1]
(Public News Service)
Pennsylvania is one of only seven states that shuts out independent voters from voting in primary elections. Two bills proposing to open the Keystone State's primary elections to roughly 1.2 million independent voters await a Senate vote.
Spending around Pa. Supreme Court race set a new record, surpassing $19.5 million [https://www.penncapital-star.com/campaigns-elections/spending-around-pa-supreme-court-race-set-a-new-record-surpassing-19-5-million/]
(Penn Capital-Star)
Driven by the likelihood that Pennsylvania’s state Supreme Court will weigh in on abortion rights in the next decade, spending in this year’s race to elect its next justice surpassed $19.5 million, setting a new record for judicial races in the commonwealth, according to campaign finance reports.

(AP News)
More criminal records in Pennsylvania can be sealed from public view and fewer people might be kept on probation or in county jails, under legislation signed by Gov. Josh Shapiro on Thursday.
A long budget impasse and partisan standoffs dominated the Pa. legislature in 2023 [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2023/12/pennsylvania-legislature-divided-2023-budget-impasse-shapiro-bipartisan/?oref=cspa_firstread_nl]
(Spotlight PA)

(PoliticsPA)
On NBC’s Sunday morning public affairs program, “Meet The Press,” analyst Steve Kornacki called Erie the “ultimate blue-collar swing county,” as it is located as close to Buffalo and Cleveland as it is to Pittsburgh. Barack Obama won the county by 16 points in 2012, while Donald Trump carried Erie by a pair of points just four years later. Joe Biden pulled out a one-point win in the northwestern corner of the state in 2020.

(The Meadville Tribune)
The state’s top elections official said Pennsylvania has seen a “pretty significant increase” of about 65 percent in voter registration applications since Gov. Josh Shapiro’s implementation of automatic voter registration at Pennsylvania Department of Transportation (PennDOT) centers in September.
Private schools, child care legislation pass in Pennsylvania as lawmakers move past budget feud [https://apnews.com/article/pennsylvania-budget-private-schools-teachers-funding-7c758e9c3f17f988d94fdb62835da6a5]
(AP News)
Lawmakers moved past a months long budget feud in Pennsylvania’s Capitol on Wednesday, advancing legislation to tie up loose ends and send millions more to subsidize private school tuition and child care tax credits for parents.

Having grown up here as an immigrant from Ecuador, she understands exactly how important it is to protect the American Dream and empower working families. She's a proven leader too: She flipped a battleground seat blue to become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. In the House, she fought tirelessly to uplift her community and win progress on the issues that matter most to families. I was incredibly proud to endorse Debbie's historic congressional campaign through Off the Sidelines. And now, I'm even prouder to support her campaign for Senate. Debbie's race is already shaping up to be one of the closest races in the country. Experts at CNN say that Rick Scott is one of the top 10 most vulnerable Senators in the country — he only won this seat by 10,033 votes. But Rick Scott is a mega-millionaire. He spent $64 million of his own fortune to buy this seat in 2018, and he's already spent $3 million airing new attack ads against Democrats like Debbie. = | | = Thank you again for being a part of this team. I'm so grateful for all that you do. With gratitude, Kirsten Gillibrand | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Reviving it will require boldness. | MY PLAN FOR ELECTION INTEGRITY NOW: ☑️ Single Day Voting ☑️ Make Election Day a National Holiday ☑️ Paper Ballots ☑️ Government-issued voter ID matched to the identification on file. ☑️ English as the only language used on ballots and in voting booths. name: Restore Our Nation
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time
188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb
This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_Joh6OMiUAJQtTXyvDiMRA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnZydkP0SoaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjMxMjIxVwNzcGNCCmWDS3qEZe_nTe1SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_Joh6OMiUAJQtTXyvDiMRA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnZydkP0SoaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjMxMjIxVwNzcGNCCmWDS3qEZe_nTe1SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_Joh6OMiUAJQtTXyvDiMRA~~/AARclAA~/RgRnZydkP0SoaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjMxMjIxVwNzcGNCCmWDS3qEZe_nTe1SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Restore Our Nation

---
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=3b4bd12829&e=567664f14c)

We're thrilled to share a [special Christmas episode of the No Doubt About It Podcast](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=cca1cbb74d&e=567664f14c) with Mark and Krysty Ronchetti, and we think it's the perfect addition to your holiday celebrations!

[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=82d7891838&e=567664f14c)

In this heartwarming Christmas episode, we had the pleasure of talking to legendary entertainment producers, SQuire Rushnell and Louise DuArt. Peter, this email is long.

But now that I'm about to wrap up my first year in Congress, I think it's important you understand my (less than conventional) road here, my experience, and what kind of leader I plan to be. [If you’re short on time, I understand, but please consider chipping in to get us closer to our $10,000 goal and keep me fighting for the most vulnerable among us in Congress >>](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/Kmop2cWTTKfz47xD6E4hLA~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRnZw_TP0TNaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1wZ2U_cmVmY29kZT0yMDIzMTIyMV9lbV9mcl9iMV9kZWZ5b2Rkc19lbi1ycyZhbW91bnQ9MjcmY2RtYz0yWnJjQm5aSmNrWnRaRkZTMTA1TjM5T0pmOEUmcmVmY29kZTI9MlpyY0JuWkpja1p0WkZGUzEwNU4zOU9KZjhFJnJlZmNvZGVjZG1jPTJacmNCblpKY2tadFpGRlMxMDVOMzlPSmY4RVcDc3BjQgplg9OKhGXdrTi3UhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAaQ~~) A victim of the system and enmeshed in trying circumstances, my biological mother turned to drugs and crime while she was pregnant with me. She didn’t have healthcare during this time and wasn’t able to see a doctor even once. As the mother of seven, she made the difficult decision to put me up for adoption because she lacked the resources to care and raise another child. I learned all of this just two months before I announced my run for Congress. **Understanding my biological mother’s story and the circumstances surrounding my birth underscored for me why politics is so important. And it further crystallized my core vision of it - that we need our elected leaders who view the world through the eyes of the most vulnerable.** My community needs a leader like that in Congress and I’m running to be that person - someone that fights every day for and with the marginalized and disadvantaged. A champion for working people. This isn’t new for me though. I’ve been fighting for my community since I was 15 years old when I became an advocate for ending gun violence following the Sandy Hook shooting. In 2018, I helped lead the ACLU of Florida’s fight to win Amendment 4, which restored voting rights to over 1.6 million Floridians who had previous felony convictions. While at the ACLU in 2020, I worked to win Biden’s support for abolishing the Hyde Amendment, legislation that has limited abortion access for millions of people. As Organizing Director at March for Our Lives, one of the largest youth political movements in the country, I led an ambitious voter turnout program that helped drive a record number of young people to the polls, helping to hold the House, and win a Democratic Senate, and Presidency. **I share all of this with you, so you understand the kind of leader I am and will continue to be.** [Peter, I didn’t make it this far on my own and I’m going to need _your support_ to continue my fight in Congress. I need to raise another $10,000 before my deadline tonight. I learned all of this just two months before I announced my run for Congress. Understanding my biological mother’s story and the circumstances surrounding my birth underscored for me why politics is so important. And it further crystallized my core vision of it - that we need our elected leaders who view the world through the eyes of the most vulnerable. My community needs a leader like that in Congress and I’m running to be that person - someone that fights every day for and with the marginalized and disadvantaged. A champion for working people. This isn’t new for me though. I’ve been fighting for my community since I was 15 years old when I became an advocate for ending gun violence following the Sandy Hook shooting. In 2018, I helped lead the ACLU of Florida’s fight to win Amendment 4, which restored voting rights to over 1.6 million Floridians who had previous felony convictions. While at the ACLU in 2020, I worked to win Biden’s support for abolishing the Hyde Amendment, legislation that has limited abortion access for millions of people. As Organizing Director at March for Our Lives, one of the largest youth political movements in the country, I led an ambitious voter turnout program that helped drive a record number of young people to the polls, helping to hold the House, and win a Democratic Senate, and Presidency. Service is how I've spent my life. I spent my career protecting our homeland. After 9/11, I was recruited into the CIA and served three tours in Iraq alongside the U.S. military. I went on to serve under presidents of both parties in the White House, and then at the Pentagon.

But what motivated me to first run for elected office was my mom. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and she didn't have health insurance. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care and having to fill out bankruptcy paperwork at the same time, forever changed me.

These experiences have shaped my time, my priorities, my approach to my four years in the U.S. House, and continue to serve as my motivation to run for Senate.

Peter, Texas is in the news for yet another heartbreaking abortion horror story caused by our state’s restrictive abortion ban. Then she learned that if she was to carry the pregnancy to term, she would be facing serious health risks. Even though it was the last thing she wanted, Taylor needed an abortion. With her health at risk and her pregnancy not viable, an abortion was her only option. body:
I am undocumented and unafraid. | | | Hi Peter, My twin sister Karen and I submitted our DACA applications at the same time. Hers was quickly accepted, and now she gets to enjoy all the protections that come along with DACA status. My application, though, was still being processed when Judge Hanen first shut down the program to new applicants in 2021. My application was frozen, and my protections have been stuck in limbo ever since. Now that DACA is likely headed to the Supreme Court again, the future of my sister’s protections are in question. And soon, we may both be at risk of detention and deportation to a country we haven’t lived in since we were two years old. That’s why I fight — because I know that our home state of Texas is big enough for all of us, despite what the fear-mongering MAGA politicians say. **They want us to go back into the shadows. But Texas is my home, and I am not afraid.** **Will you join me in the fight to create a better future for us all with permanent protections for DACA recipients like my sister, and folks DACA left behind like me? clean_body: I am undocumented and unafraid. | | | Hi Peter, My twin sister Karen and I submitted our DACA applications at the same time. Hers was quickly accepted, and now she gets to enjoy all the protections that come along with DACA status. My application, though, was still being processed when Judge Hanen first shut down the program to new applicants in 2021. My application was frozen, and my protections have been stuck in limbo ever since. Now that DACA is likely headed to the Supreme Court again, the future of my sister’s protections are in question. And soon, we may both be at risk of detention and deportation to a country we haven’t lived in since we were two years old. That’s why I fight — because I know that our home state of Texas is big enough for all of us, despite what the fear-mongering MAGA politicians say. They want us to go back into the shadows. But Texas is my home, and I am not afraid. Will you join me in the fight to create a better future for us all with permanent protections for DACA recipients like my sister, and folks DACA left behind like me? UWDA is leading the charge for a pathway to citizenship, and we need your help in this urgent moment: _Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue. | | | | | | | | | | With your support, we can make my dreams, Karen’s dreams, my parents’ dreams, and the dreams of millions of undocumented people like me a reality. Thank you! Judith, United We Dream Action

name: Dawn Moore
subject: From our family to yours
body:
Friend, our family loves the holiday season.

As we start thinking about Christmas gifts, one thing is on my mind: how can we do right by ALL Maryland families, who work hard, love each other, and celebrate together, just like us?

Wes is working to make sure families across our state not only survive but thrive. With less than a year into his administration, Wes has already raised the minimum wage and launched programs to uplift children out of poverty.

And he’s just getting started.

But the truth is: Wes hates asking you for money, even though it’s critical. So I’m going to do it for him because I truly believe in the hard work that Wes is doing to uplift Maryland families.

It’s because of people like you willing to chip in here and there however they can that we were able to make historic change. So, if you can afford to, pitch in $10 or more right now to come through for Wes. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231221-1?refcode=em20231221]

Contribute » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20231221-1?refcode=em20231221]

Wes and I deeply appreciate anything and everything you do for us. We can’t slow down now.

Thank you for pitching in,

Dawn Flythe Moore
First Lady of Maryland

---

**Matt Dolan files petitions to run for U.S. Senate.**
* This week, Matt Dolan officially [filed his petitions](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=83044c91fdfd435097a7adf60cb7482d&_e=gl-YUph51-gjzpUEMy5f8ho7Ao-ZX8k2I-VwjKnD4a9nfRIryyprmVF4F3GDj6-qNUB-zEHTJFVkJ09n9grB3z9vd8YxRLvQ2W0rEWJaJ7BiN_XrzU5JYs4cNp-NgpX9H7LvLS1UEdJTaIYoomVl0nC07WDdVB-3nRIgIuzt2w2crXMhDRSY1hLFo5X7BRy5tNlJCI8wUhMr7dE4g-K5hcbQw_Alm30MZHk0f5jF9lRTz51BMQ5JCpuUGiCbtXpMZ34XiTGpgku3eUBSoVt0yQ%3D%3D) to run for the U.S. Senate!

* Matt’s Statement: “Joe Biden and Sherrod Brown’s leftist agenda has created a state of crisis in America. Our sovereignty is under threat, our economy is under stress and our safety at home and abroad is at risk. Ohioans want a problem solver who has successfully faced challenges impacting our quality of life, not the political blame game that lacks commonsense solutions.”

* Among all Republican candidates, Matt Dolan routinely polls the strongest against Sherrod Brown. Dolan ends the year with more primary cash on hand than Bernie Moreno and Frank LaRose combined.

body:
| | | Hi Peter, I have exciting news to share about the Owyhee Canyonlands: [the Malheur Community Empowerment for the Owyhee Act (S. 1890) passed out of committee last week!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75599495/445160574/-1443505139?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZhNGQ1ZmJhLTM4YTAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=g_6StiLCaJgXwS9oBFRkMKXd7qohUymwBCIcTkhaKtw=&emci=e272bfc3-969f-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=fa4d5fba-38a0-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=2107230) This is a huge milestone in the decades-long effort to protect the Owyhee; no legislation has made it to this moment. This is a testament to the strong relationships and broad stakeholder coalition that Senator Wyden has built while drafting this legislation. We’re encouraged by the legislative progress but recognize that the work isn’t over. We need to show Congress why the Owyhee Canyonlands deserve to be protected, and we need your support to do it. [**Will you share your Owyhee story?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75599496/445160575/-959356660?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZhNGQ1ZmJhLTM4YTAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=g_6StiLCaJgXwS9oBFRkMKXd7qohUymwBCIcTkhaKtw=&emci=e272bfc3-969f-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=fa4d5fba-38a0-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=2107230) Whether you’ve been to the Owyhee Canyonlands once years ago, visit them on a regular basis, just have hopes of making it there someday, or anywhere in between-- [share why you want to see permanent protections for the Owyhee Canyonlands.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75599498/445160578/-959356660?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZhNGQ1ZmJhLTM4YTAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=g_6StiLCaJgXwS9oBFRkMKXd7qohUymwBCIcTkhaKtw=&emci=e272bfc3-969f-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=fa4d5fba-38a0-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=2107230)
Thanks for your support!

Britney VanCitters
Political & Organizing Director, OLCV P.S. Thank you to those of you who’ve already submitted your stories-- I’ve really enjoyed reading them! |

clean_body: | | | Hi Peter, I have exciting news to share about the Owyhee Canyonlands: This is a huge milestone in the decades-long effort to protect the Owyhee; no legislation has made it to this moment. This is a testament to the strong relationships and broad stakeholder coalition that Senator Wyden has built while drafting this legislation. We’re encouraged by the legislative progress but recognize that the work isn’t over. We need to show Congress why the Owyhee Canyonlands deserve to be protected, and we need your support to do it. Whether you’ve been to the Owyhee Canyonlands once years ago, visit them on a regular basis, just have hopes of making it there someday, or anywhere in between-- Thanks for your support! Britney VanCitters Political & Organizing Director, OLCV P.S. Peter, Happy Holidays! With the calendar year heading to a close, I can’t help but reflect on how much we accomplished in 2023. 🚨 Declaring a homelessness state of emergency on my first full day in office, and two months later signing the Affordable Housing and Emergency Homelessness Response Package into law. 🎒 Signing seven new education initiatives into law aimed at increasing literacy, growing the teacher workforce, and improving student equity. 🚌 Traveling to every corner of the state as part of the One Oregon Listening Tour — meeting directly with community leaders to hear their concerns and learn about their issues firsthand. 👫 Joining 20 of my fellow Governors to form the Reproductive Freedom Alliance in response to the nationwide attacks on abortion access. Our coalition is dedicated to protecting and expanding reproductive rights across the country. 🧹 Announcing a $1 million investment to expand trash cleanup efforts across the City of Portland. We’re going to have a cleaner city while supporting individuals exiting homelessness. 🏥 Cracking down on fentanyl in our state, by ramping up targeted law enforcement efforts to go after dealers, increasing intervention programs, and implementing more prevention efforts to combat risky behavior among Oregon’s youth. And so much more! It’s been a fast-paced year, and I’m only getting started in my work to improve the lives of all Oregonians by making progress on the state’s biggest priorities: housing and homelessness, education and childcare, and mental health and addiction care. clean_body: | Peter, Happy Holidays! With the calendar year heading to a close, I can’t help but reflect on how much we accomplished in 2023. 🚨 Declaring a homelessness state of emergency on my first full day in office, and two months later signing the Affordable Housing and Emergency Homelessness Response Package into law. 🎒 Signing seven new education initiatives into law aimed at increasing literacy, growing the teacher workforce, and improving student equity. 🚌 Traveling to every corner of the state as part of the One Oregon Listening Tour — meeting directly with community leaders to hear their concerns and learn about their issues firsthand. 👫 Joining 20 of my fellow Governors to form the Reproductive Freedom Alliance in response to the nationwide attacks on abortion access. Our coalition is dedicated to protecting and expanding reproductive rights across the country. 🧹 Announcing a $1 million investment to expand trash cleanup efforts across the City of Portland. We’re going to have a cleaner city while supporting individuals exiting homelessness. 🏥 Cracking down on fentanyl in our state, by ramping up targeted law enforcement efforts to go after dealers, increasing intervention programs, and implementing more prevention efforts to combat risky behavior among Oregon’s youth. And so much more! It’s been a fast-paced year, and I’m only getting started in my work to improve the lives of all Oregonians by making progress on the state’s biggest priorities: housing and homelessness, education and childcare, and mental health and addiction care. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Thank you for being on my side this year! | Hi everyone,

I hope you are doing well and having a great holiday season so far. I just wanted to take some time to tell you all how grateful I am for all of your kind birthday wishes and your generous support for the work we do at my Climate PAC.

I’d especially like to thank my friend Shepard Fairey for sharing his new piece with us. Shepard’s talent for capturing the spirit of social and political movements is unparalleled. And the way he’s transformed this impactful moment in my life into something so visually striking and emotionally resonant is truly remarkable.

Shepard, from the bottom of my heart, thank you for lending your extraordinary talent to celebrate this milestone in my life and for standing alongside me in the fight for a better, more just world. I know you will continue to use your art to inspire countless others in the way you’ve inspired me.

I know that circulating and celebrating a mugshot may seem odd to many people, so I thought I would take a moment to share a bit of the backstory behind this one.

Reflecting on my arrest in 1970, it's clear now how much it has shaped my identity as an activist. At that time, I was deeply involved in the anti-Vietnam War movement, traveling around the U.S. to speak about the war and, in particular, about the [_Winter Soldier Investigation_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75603177/445172353/2107104599?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0OGVlMmM4LTQyYTAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=E7xshTLwjo2kikTRjLuASAlqENo_je0WaJTOYY0Jdds=&emci=af2b8b2b-769f-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=348ee2c8-42a0-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=4823105) that some of us were organizing together with Vietnam Veterans Against the War.

During a stop in Cleveland, I found myself embroiled in a situation that seemed almost surreal. I was accused of drug smuggling, but the charges were purely fabricated, a ploy to disrupt my activism. The arresting officer even admitted he was acting under orders from the Nixon White House.

What stands out in my memory is the sense of defiance I felt. Despite being handcuffed, I managed to raise my fist in a gesture of resistance, something I was able to do because of my double-jointed hands.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75603180/445172357/420108225?refcode=BLU_EM_JANE_2023-12-21_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0OGVlMmM4LTQyYTAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=E7xshTLwjo2kikTRjLuASAlqENo_je0WaJTOYY0Jdds=)
I spent a night in jail, but the absurdity of the charges became evident quickly. The supposed drugs were nothing more than vitamins. It was a clear case of political harassment, an attempt to silence my voice against the Vietnam War.

This incident only fueled my determination to fight for what I believed in, not to be cowed by those in power who sought to silence dissent.

Decades later, I'm honored that this moment in my life can serve as an inspiration to artists like Shepard and activists like all of you to fight for what they believe in.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75603183/445172359/420108225?refcode=BLU_EM_JANE_2023-12-21_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0OGVlMmM4LTQyYTAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=E7xshTLwjo2kikTRjLuASAlqENo_je0WaJTOYY0Jdds=)
Thank you all so much once again.

I really enjoyed sharing this special day with you. Even though today is my birthday, it’s not too late for you to join in the celebration! [_**You can share a message with me and support our work by purchasing some of our exclusive merchandise based on Shepard’s new illustration.**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75603185/445172361/420108225?refcode=BLU_EM_JANE_2023-12-21_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM0OGVlMmM4LTQyYTAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=E7xshTLwjo2kikTRjLuASAlqENo_je0WaJTOYY0Jdds=)

Thank you so much, and happy holidays!
Jane Fonda

_Hey there, it’s Alex. I know it’s a busy time of year, but I wanted to make sure to pass along this message from Jon Tester. Please,[**read his note below and then consider chipping in $17.77 to help hold our Democratic Senate majority.](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-tester-december23.O4FlB_&refcode=em231221-1-t1&t=8&akid=1628%2E159979%2EEALv9S)** \- Alex_
* * *

I won’t lie to you, team:
**I’m stressed out.** My finance team just called me to let me know we’re still about $50,000 short of our end-of-year fundraising goal.
[**Before I explain any more, I wanted to ask: Could you split a donation between Alex Padilla and my campaign to help us close the gap before our December end-of-year fundraising goal?](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-tester-december23.O4FlB_&refcode=em231221-1-t1&t=9&akid=1628%2E159979%2EEALv9S)**
**[DONATE](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-tester-december23.O4FlB_&refcode=em231221-1-t1&t=10&akid=1628%2E159979%2EEALv9S)**
Look, Montanans deserve someone who will crack down on the special interests and corruption in Washington, not play political games and cut backroom deals.
We need to fight to lower costs for hardworking families, create good-paying union jobs, and ensure rural communities have what they need, like reliable internet and hospitals within driving distance.
Folks, I’m pretty different from most people who end up in the U.S. Senate. **I still farm the same land my grandparents homesteaded 100 years ago, and I try every day to do what’s right for the people of Montana and across the country.**
Because of that, I don’t have much patience for the fancy billionaires and shady super PACs that think they should be in charge. **Instead, I listen to and depend on grassroots supporters like you.**
That’s why I’m grateful you even opened this email. My team assures me that emails like this one make up a big part of our budget—and chipping in five or ten bucks goes a long way in a campaign like ours.
**So, here’s the part where I ask:** [**Can you make a contribution of $17.77 (our average online donation) today to help us meet our fundraising goal? Your donation will be split between my campaign and Alex Padilla to help us respond to the onslaught of out-of-state money coming in to attack my record.](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-tester-december23.O4FlB_&refcode=em231221-1-t1&t=11&akid=1628%2E159979%2EEALv9S)**
_If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution between Alex Padilla and Jon Tester instantly:_

When I was elected to Congress, one of the first things I had to do was find a part-time residence in D.C., and what better way to get to know the city than with a housemate! And I got really lucky with my housemate and fellow Freshman Democrat, Representative Morgan McGarvey (KY-03)!
As brand new members of Congress, Morgan and I experienced a slew of surprises when we arrived in Congress, mostly new levels of extremism and dysfunction at the hands of the GOP. But, we also got to share many new (positive!) experiences, learn about each other’s districts, and renew our commitment to protecting working families across the country.
So as we both head into our first reelection year, I have a request:
**[Can you please split a $5 contribution between Rep. Morgan McGarvey and my reelection campaigns today? We need to do our part in defending our seats so we can help flip the House blue in 2024.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75603402/445173397/2028774296?refcode2=4bc242e4-43a0-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&refcode=em231221-1-t2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YmMyNDJlNC00M2EwLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5MPPv4nihvIw3tbnmwjoW6s_cVhXPSVjfmEIdgKL9rs=)**

Let me tell you a bit more about Morgan:
Morgan is a lifelong Louisvillian who now proudly represents Kentucky’s 3rd congressional district. As a Kentucky native, he has devoted his life to serving the people of his state, serving a decade in the Kentucky State Senate before running for Congress.
Like myself, Morgan deeply cares about bettering the lives of Americans and has been a devoted supporter of public education, organized labor, and abortion rights. He has always put the needs of working families first in his policymaking.
And just recently, he passed his first bill in Congress to protect the education benefits of veterans, and it passed unanimously! As a freshman!
Morgan is a rising leader in Congress, and we need to make sure we continue to have his voice in the People’s House.

# FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Peter,I am a lifelong supporter and defender of Israel. I do so on moral grounds, because of our shared values and because she has many vicious enemies. In particular, I've found much of the mainstream press coverage of Israel to be appalling. It's often misleading, inaccurate, and just plain biased. **Now, as Israel faces a desperate fight for its future, I’ve increasingly found myself turning to the outstanding and unique coverage of The New York Sun**.
---
| | [Join the Sun Now →](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=71a2c45909bc4837ac49fffdbbdaf639&_e=aDttXa3USbPNoxi7zGxH4rZZv8zYnyDOfQeDJLvunE-RVWO3fOZY6rRUaG9dgk-PJJTn_7cHY7cMWsnMxxvzzMFP-lWcMTjyp6XsLsd0PGKIDFIi9K8ZIeF2Rz4W9nVfyJgczdCjwlT9D9Is8B0DlpVst3Ga58l5e5jrrDGFbJ_sD5rzL50Z2Wh83JLUKVNqZPgs_Rowzz70UyfdGKaNzpqC6rEPt4P8fG8Lc93rgrUzdTRkIEnuqXQYiLxmRjCZKZfh57Jh-T02Tey2OsrFIG02n-tZdgYJABGhpPyb8svXa6Pe553bPRWBS90wJrlJjIB9R9Fsv7mXasR4C3Y2HkM_-AoJLwloj2xhh6P09Gpt6yHdhQ80ED53GJqVZ2XnBMerPg9iB0yFoSY9I1ioig%3D%3D)
---
| | The Sun takes the side of right over popular. I consider the Sun to be one of Israel’s most ardent defenders in the American press. Let's look back at 10 of Cori's accomplishments from this past year | |
---
Peter, **** **** **** There are just TEN DAYS left in 2023, so we wanted to highlight TEN things Congresswoman Cori Bush has done this year.
1. **Introduced the Reparations Now resolution** , recognizing that the United States has a moral and legal obligation to provide reparations for the enslavement of Africans and its lasting harm on the lives of millions of Black people in the United States.
2. **Introduced the** **Reproductive Health Travel Fund Act** to provide grant assistance for those who travel long distances to receive reproductive health care, including abortion care.
3. **Introduced the** **End Solitary Confinement Act** , historic legislation which would end solitary confinement in federal prison and detention facilities, establish minimum standards for incarceration and due process protections, and incentivize states and localities to end solitary in state and local facilities.
4. **Introduced the Ceasefire Now Resolution** , a resolution urging the Biden Administration to call for an immediate de-escalation and ceasefire in Israel and occupied Palestine, and to send humanitarian aid and assistance to Gaza.
5. **Introduced the Unhoused Bill Of Rights** , is the first federal resolution to declare unalienable rights for unhoused persons and provide solutions to permanently end the crisis by 2027.
6. **Brought $18.4 million in community funding** projects.
7. **Brought over $600 million in federal funding** to the district.
8. **Introduced the Insulin For All Act,** legislation that would cap the list price of insulin. It would prohibit pharmaceutical manufacturers from charging more than $20 per vial.
9. **Introduced the ERA Now Resolution** , urging the Archivist of the United States to certify the state ratifications, and publish the Equal Rights Amendment in the federal register, cementing it as a formal part of the U.S. Constitution.
10. **Introduced the People’s Response Ac** t, groundbreaking legislation that would advance an inclusive, holistic, and health-centered approach to public safety by creating a public safety division within the United States Department of Human Health and Services — because communities and experts agree that public safety is a matter of public health.

clean_body: Let's look back at 10 of Cori's accomplishments from this past year | | Peter, ** There are just TEN DAYS left in 2023, so we wanted to highlight TEN things Congresswoman Cori Bush has done this year. 1. Introduced the Reparations Now resolution , recognizing that the United States has a moral and legal obligation to provide reparations for the enslavement of Africans and its lasting harm on the lives of millions of Black people in the United States. 2. Introduced the Reproductive Health Travel Fund Act to provide grant assistance for those who travel long distances to receive reproductive health care, including abortion care. 3. Introduced the End Solitary Confinement Act , historic legislation which would end solitary confinement in federal prison and detention facilities, establish minimum standards for incarceration and due process protections, and incentivize states and localities to end solitary in state and local facilities. 4. Introduced the Ceasefire Now Resolution , a resolution urging the Biden Administration to call for an immediate de-escalation and ceasefire in Israel and occupied Palestine, and to send humanitarian aid and assistance to Gaza. 5. Introduced the Unhoused Bill Of Rights , is the first federal resolution to declare unalienable rights for unhoused persons and provide solutions to permanently end the crisis by 2027. 6. Brought $18.4 million in community funding projects. 7. Brought over $600 million in federal funding to the district. 8. Introduced the Insulin For All Act, legislation that would cap the list price of insulin. It would prohibit pharmaceutical manufacturers from charging more than $20 per vial. 9. Introduced the ERA Now Resolution , urging the Archivist of the United States to certify the state ratifications, and publish the Equal Rights Amendment in the federal register, cementing it as a formal part of the U.S. Constitution. 10. Introduced the People’s Response Ac t, groundbreaking legislation that would advance an inclusive, holistic, and health-centered approach to public safety by creating a public safety division within the United States Department of Human Health and Services — because communities and experts agree that public safety is a matter of public health. Cori would not have been able to do this without your support and the power of our movement. | | Peter,

Texas’ extreme abortion ban is putting lives at risk. No one should have to petition a court to receive life-saving medical care. **Today, I am thinking about Kate Cox and how our state's courts put her life in danger by denying her a medically necessary abortion.**

**This should have been between her, her family, and her doctor — not the courts and politicians.** The denial of reproductive health rights held by Texas women for nearly 50 years is one of the most dire threats our state faces. Women should have the right to make decisions about their health without the interference of politicians.

Over the years, I’ve operated on women facing death from reproductive emergencies, and it's unacceptable any person would be denied life-saving care. I trust women to make their own healthcare decisions, and it’s unacceptable that Texas women no longer have the freedom to make their own reproductive choices.

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. body:
https://www.dean24.com [https://www.dean24.com]
Hi Friend,
Let’s be honest, things in America aren’t at their best.
We're facing an affordability crisis, climate change, a broken and corrupt healthcare system, and much more. We’ve got important matters that distracted, and frankly aged, leadership isn’t adequately addressing for its people.
That’s why I believe it is time to pass the torch to a new generation.
People of the past are not well positioned to shepard the country into the future. America needs new leaders who will step up and move us forward with innovation, collaboration, and honesty. That’s why I’m running for President — to help turn the page and move this country forward.
It’s time we fight for policies that make groceries, housing, childcare, and education more affordable. We need to pursue real climate action, pass campaign finance reform to keep undue influence out of politics, and truly address America’s healthcare crisis.
Let’s throw out old systems that aren’t working and bring 21st-century ideas to Washington to solve 21st-century problems. As President, I promise to surround myself with diverse, young, and thoughtful experts who will work together to ensure America is at the forefront of innovation, progress, and inclusive leadership.
By fostering a team that reflects the richness of our nation's perspectives, we will forge a path towards a brighter future, where every voice is heard, and the collective strength of our diversity continues to be our greatest asset.
Together, we'll build a nation that thrives on unity, resilience, and the boundless potential of its people.
It is time to embrace a new chapter in American Leadership. Together, we can shape a brighter tomorrow.
Join us!
Dean

To meet our goal we’ll need a few people who don’t normally give, to chip in. I’m hoping that’s you! If so, here’s the link to make your first donation: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-email?refcode=email](http://numerolinks.lateefahsimon.com/f/a/lrCmbASdxSxF0tWWDFRSFw~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRnZzziP0Q7aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2xzLWVtYWlsP3JlZmNvZGU9RGVjMjEtMjNXA3NwY0IKZYPnt4Rl969m21IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAABE~)

#
There are just three things we need you to know before our end of year fundraising deadline.
1.**Alexandria doesn’t attend fancy cocktail party fundraisers or curry favor with billionaires.** This is a movement of, for, and made possible by thousands of people like you.
2\. **Our average contribution this month is just $15.68.** We rely only on small dollar support to fight Republican extremism and push for progressive change.
3\. **Alexandria already has at least one MAGA Republican opponent.** In 2020, our challenger raised and spent more than $10 million against us. The disinformation they sow discredits our movement unless we fight back.
We depend on thousands of people from NY-14 and beyond to power this movement and fight Republican extremism.
[Will you contribute $5 right now to help us reach our end of year goal? # & Happy New Year 🎄🌟
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=22d3b3c82a&e=0a12281e0e)
Dear Friends and Supporters,
As we gather with loved ones, surrounded by the warmth of the holiday season, I wanted to take a moment to extend my heartfelt wishes to each and every one of you. Merry Christmas and a joyous New Year filled with hope, happiness, and prosperity.
2023 has been a year of resilience and resilience defines us as Americans. Reflecting on the past year, we've faced challenges and triumphs that have shaped our country. Yet, throughout it all, your unwavering support has been a beacon of strength. Your dedication to our shared vision of a better future for our country and Maryland’s 6th Congressional District continues to inspire me.
In the spirit of the season of giving, I invite you to consider supporting our campaign with a special Christmas donation. Your generosity will enable us to amplify our efforts, reach more voters, and advocate more effectively for the conservative values we hold dear.
Your belief in our campaign fuels our determination to serve, uplift, and represent the voices of our community. Your donation, no matter the size, is a powerful gesture that empowers us to continue this important work in our campaign for Congress.
To contribute, please visit our [**donation page here**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b8bfe7fc37&e=0a12281e0e) and join us in helping flip Maryland’s 6th district back for Republicans. Your support means the world to us here at Team Roca.
Thank you for being an integral part of this journey. May this holiday season fill your hearts with love, joy, and cherished moments with your loved ones.
Wishing you all a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! 🎄
Warmest regards,

When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and still struggling to afford rent for our small, one-room apartment.

**So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop**. It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality.

We were able to move out of that one-room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. **I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate.**

**Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress.** **I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change._And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign next November._**

[_**That's why I'm asking you to chip in just $10 — about the cost of a dozen doughnuts — to send me to the Senate. clean_body: I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change. And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign next November. | Peter, I'm about to ask you to help me hit my $150,000 end-of-year goal. But first, I want to tell you a story about doughnuts — and how they're going to help us save our Senate majority. = = When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and still struggling to afford rent for our small, one-room apartment. So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop. It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality. We were able to move out of that one-room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate. Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change.And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign next November. = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you so much, Debbie Mucarsel-Powell * | | = Paid for by Fight for Progress PAC and not authorized by any candidate or any candidate's committee. Friend, We don’t need more millionaires in Congress who can self-finance their campaigns. We need regular working people who understand the needs of their constituents. Right now, the vast majority of Americans support a ceasefire, and they don't want to see their tax dollars go to more war. Many of our communities still don't have clean water, and most families are living paycheck to paycheck, deciding between paying medical bills or putting food on the table. Many are on the brink of homelessness. **We need elected leaders who don’t take money from corporations, who represent their constituents as public servants, and who are not afraid to stand up to the unjust status quo.** That’s why I created my Rooted in Community Leadership PAC―to train, support, and elect these leaders. Already, anti-Palestinian group AIPAC has pledged to spend $100 million in an attempt to defeat members of Congress who’ve been leading our ceasefire movement. clean_body: Marginalized communities are feeling unheard and betrayed. | | | Friend, We don’t need more millionaires in Congress who can self-finance their campaigns. We need regular working people who understand the needs of their constituents. Right now, the vast majority of Americans support a ceasefire, and they don't want to see their tax dollars go to more war. Many of our communities still don't have clean water, and most families are living paycheck to paycheck, deciding between paying medical bills or putting food on the table. Many are on the brink of homelessness. We need elected leaders who don’t take money from corporations, who represent their constituents as public servants, and who are not afraid to stand up to the unjust status quo. That’s why I created my Rooted in Community Leadership PAC―to train, support, and elect these leaders. Already, anti-Palestinian group AIPAC has pledged to spend $100 million in an attempt to defeat members of Congress who’ve been leading our ceasefire movement. They’ve already spent hundreds of thousands of dollars in attack ads against me, Jamaal Bowman, and Summer Lee this month. | Peter,

As we begin to wrap up the year, I want to take a moment to reflect. This year has had lots of ups and downs, but in the spirit of ending the year on a good note, I want to share a few things I’m looking forward to in 2024:
1. My background as a labor rights lawyer and activist has grounded my work in Congress. I’ve never been afraid to kick ass for the working class. Next year, I’m looking forward to continuing on that path and working to preserve essential services like Medicare and Social Security.

2. As the first woman to lead BOLD PAC, the campaign arm of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, I’m looking forward to putting my plans into action and helping elect Latino progressives to Congress.

3. A lot hinges on Democrats’ control of the House. I’m looking forward to taking back the House next year and making some real progress on everything from protecting the right to abortion to passing life-saving gun legislation.
