body:
I’m fighting to protect and secure the right to an abortion nationwide |
---
Peter – my name is Whitney Shanahan. I’m a proud mother, a passionate abortion rights advocate, and a progressive Democrat. I’m launching my run against GOP Congressman Darrell Issa in California’s 48th District. In a moment, [I’m going to ask you to become a founding donor by splitting a donation between Defeat Republicans and my campaign,](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75609123/445191725/2109438718?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_231221_1_2&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc5ZjBiYWNhLTU1YTAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9vgfPLv6Il66uUisl61gjAv04cUG__Sux-JZzbKFVlM=) but first, let me tell you a little bit about why I’m running! ➡️➡️➡️

In 2019, in Ohio where I was born and raised, Republicans in our state legislature launched an all-out assault on reproductive rights by trying to pass a 6-week abortion ban. At the time, I was pregnant and furious that a group of mostly men were attempting to control and govern my body.

I knew I had to fight back. So I took to the steps of the Statehouse with a group of resilient women and led protests to protect abortion rights all across Ohio and nationwide.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75609125/445191726/2109438718?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_231221_1_2&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc5ZjBiYWNhLTU1YTAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9vgfPLv6Il66uUisl61gjAv04cUG__Sux-JZzbKFVlM=)
Within months, we had thousands of members and formed Pro Choice with Heart, a citizen-led initiative to show up and stand up for reproductive rights. And although this bill unfortunately ended up passing, we in turn created a network of hundreds of thousands of advocates that continually and consistently show up and fight for our right to an abortion, no matter the circumstances.

Today, living in San Diego County with my husband and 4 year-old son, I am at a similar crossroads to where I was in 2019. I am represented by one of the most far-right Congressmen in the country, Darrell Issa.

A career politician and one of the richest men in the House of Representatives, Congressman Issa believes it’s his right to govern other people’s bodies. He’s worked to defund vital resources like Planned Parenthood, celebrated the overturning of _Roe v. Wade,_ and has been complicit in attempts by his colleagues to issue a nationwide abortion ban.

**I’m fighting back by running against him and his barbaric beliefs. I’m running to represent the voices of thousands across this district, and millions across the country that believe abortion rights are human rights.**

With the recent victory in Ohio, where voters stood up and demanded reproductive rights be added to their states constitution, it has shown us that now more than ever, people are motivated to fight for our right to an abortion. It’s important we realize in this race here in San Diego County, abortion is on the ballot. And that’s why I’m stepping up to face Congressman Issa, but I need your help, Peter.

**To defeat Darrell Issa, I need the support of a huge grassroots team to make sure we can take on his millions of personal wealth and his legion of anti-abortion supporters.** [So I am personally asking, can you stand with me and our fight for reproductive rights by splitting a donation between Defeat Republicans and my campaign? ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75609126/445191727/2109438718?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_231221_1_2&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc5ZjBiYWNhLTU1YTAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=9vgfPLv6Il66uUisl61gjAv04cUG__Sux-JZzbKFVlM=)

clean_body: I’m fighting to protect and secure the right to an abortion nationwide | Peter – my name is Whitney Shanahan. I’m a proud mother, a passionate abortion rights advocate, and a progressive Democrat. I’m launching my run against GOP Congressman Darrell Issa in California’s 48th District. In a moment, = but first, let me tell you a little bit about why I’m running! ➡️➡️➡️ In 2019, in Ohio where I was born and raised, Republicans in our state legislature launched an all-out assault on reproductive rights by trying to pass a 6-week abortion ban. At the time, I was pregnant and furious that a group of mostly men were attempting to control and govern my body. I knew I had to fight back. So I took to the steps of the Statehouse with a group of resilient women and led protests to protect abortion rights all across Ohio and nationwide. = Within months, we had thousands of members and formed Pro Choice with Heart, a citizen-led initiative to show up and stand up for reproductive rights. And although this bill unfortunately ended up passing, we in turn created a network of hundreds of thousands of advocates that continually and consistently show up and fight for our right to an abortion, no matter the circumstances. Today, living in San Diego County with my husband and 4 year-old son, I am at a similar crossroads to where I was in 2019. I am represented by one of the most far-right Congressmen in the country, Darrell Issa. A career politician and one of the richest men in the House of Representatives, Congressman Issa believes it’s his right to govern other people’s bodies. He’s worked to defund vital resources like Planned Parenthood, celebrated the overturning of Roe v. Wade, and has been complicit in attempts by his colleagues to issue a nationwide abortion ban. I’m fighting back by running against him and his barbaric beliefs. I’m running to represent the voices of thousands across this district, and millions across the country that believe abortion rights are human rights. With the recent victory in Ohio, where voters stood up and demanded reproductive rights be added to their states constitution, it has shown us that now more than ever, people are motivated to fight for our right to an abortion. It’s important we realize in this race here in San Diego County, abortion is on the ballot. And that’s why I’m stepping up to face Congressman Issa, but I need your help, Peter. subject: Big news: CRA files ethics complaint against Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson
body:
As we have proven, if you have the will to fight and know where to look we can hold them accountable. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us1.campaign-archive.com/?e=17913c7d6d&u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=94e34147ed)
---
| | |
---
| | | Friends,

I know Christmas is around the corner, but my team is still working hard and we have big news to share.

Earlier this week, after months of careful preparation, we filed an official ethics complaint against Biden-appointed _Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson_ for willfully failing to disclose the source of her husband’s consulting income and her potential failure to disclose private contributions made to an event celebrating her appointment to the Supreme Court.

**Conservative justices are held to entirely different ethical standards in our judicial system that their liberal counterparts. You know it and I know it.**

**[But with your generous support, we’re making sure that changes](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=687a607950&e=17913c7d6d). **

As I told Fox News, Ketanji Brown Jackson’s "disturbing trend of not reporting material sources of income and gifts" has "shielded potential conflicts of interest from public scrutiny.”
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=93cecd5f67&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| That’s why in the [letter we sent](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=d056205ef4&e=17913c7d6d) to the Judicial Conference, which has administrative oversight over the Supreme Court, we detail how Justice Jackson must be investigated for repeatedly failing to disclose her husband’s income from medical consulting and potentially private contributions that were made to a swanky event in her honor.

Friends, liberal justices on the Supreme Court should not be immune from public scrutiny. As we have proven, if you have the will to fight and know where to look we can hold them accountable.

Trust me when I say, this is just the beginning.

As you consider [your end-of-year giving](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=c851af449c&e=17913c7d6d), please remember this initiative because it is an example of an opportunity seized when our organization is being well-resourced and growing.
---
| Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President
Center for Renewing America

Hi Peter, how are you?
